admin-building-with-us-distribution.description: Navegar desde Comercial, copiar la URL inglesa, descargar el PDF y cambiar el idioma de la vista previa sin cambiar la URL del panel; reintentar un fallo del resumen.

admin-building-with-us-history.name: Admin Building with Us History
admin-building-with-us-history.description: Consultar la versión vigente, autor y nota; pulsar Ver más para cargar offset=20 y reintentar un fallo del historial.

admin-client-archived-tab.name: Admin Client Archived Tab
admin-client-archived-tab.description: The Archivados option of the transversal client-status selector (next to the search box, labelled with its own match count, mirrored in ?status=) lists only archived clients (archived=true, with the pre-rename ?inactive= spelling still accepted), and the row toggle archives a client or brings it back.

admin-client-change-history.name: Admin Client Change History
admin-client-change-history.description: Expande un cliente y abre Ver historial de cambios; consulta identidad, contacto y facturación con autor y fecha; pagina y compara versiones. El historial presenta fecha, autor, origen y cambios; carga 20 entradas por página. Evidencia antigua incompleta no se puede comparar. Errores de carga, consulta o comparación permiten reintentar.

admin-client-communications.name: Admin Client Communications Registry
admin-client-communications.description: Admin abre Configuraciones junto a Nuevo hilo y administra preferencias personales de navegación, orden, paginación, canal inicial, ayuda y ancho, persistidas por cuenta entre dispositivos. La navegación muestra todos los proyectos aunque tengan cero hilos, conserva PRUEBA y separa los proyectos archivados por su estado. También identifica y busca hilos mediante tarjetas compactas de título y metadata, sin contenido del mensaje ni desplazamiento horizontal, aplica filtros prediseñados con conteos, conserva vistas propias al restablecer las de fábrica y registra mensajes bidireccionales con estados y documentos referenciados. Paridad con el gestor documental (2026-08-31): cada proyecto tiene su comunicacion madre y cada cliente puede adoptar la suya (thread_kind: project/client/manual); el catalogo de entidades y las comunicaciones propias —los hilos sin proyecto— viven en secciones plegables cuyo pliegue se recuerda; el interruptor de proyectos no activos es EXCLUYENTE; y un eje de archivado independiente de abierto/cerrado saca hilos de la vista sin cerrarlos, con la madre protegida de archivarse. Lectura del hilo con IDs de hilo/mensaje/documento, saltos al inicio y final del histórico, redacción y detalles plegables sin pérdida de datos, copia directa y marcado de enviado dentro de Más. Búsqueda exacta por #ID.

admin-client-create-standalone.name: Admin Client Create Standalone
admin-client-create-standalone.description: Create a new client profile from /panel/clients via the compact modal form, with and without email. The canonical profile stores contact name, company/legal name, real or placeholder email, phone, NIT or personal C.C., address and billing code. The selected document type saves a C.C. in cedula instead of nit. These fields supply the same billing_customer projection consumed by new cuentas de cobro.

admin-client-delete-orphan.name: Admin Client Delete Orphan
admin-client-delete-orphan.description: Delete an orphan client (zero proposals + zero projects) via the trash icon and confirm modal.

admin-client-delete-protected.name: Admin Client Delete Protected
admin-client-delete-protected.description: Verify that active clients (with proposals or projects) do not expose the delete trash icon.

admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.name: Admin Client Document-Signed Notification
admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.description: When a client click-to-accept signs a document (POST /api/accounts/documents/:uuid/sign/), notify_team_document_signed_task fires a team milestone alert (in-app to project admins + email) and the client receives a signature-confirmation email. Best-effort; idempotent re-signs do not re-notify.
admin-client-document-signed-notificatio.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope; may be asserted as a branch of platform-client-document-sign.

admin-client-drag-reassign.name: Admin Client Drag Reassign
admin-client-drag-reassign.description: Drag a proposal or diagnostic row from an expanded client and drop it on another client card header or its matching proposals/diagnostics zone to reassign it (PATCH client_id) with an undo notification; details and list refresh silently in place.

admin-client-edit.name: Admin Client Edit
admin-client-edit.description: Admin edits an existing client profile from /panel/clients by clicking the edit (pencil) icon on a client row. The edit modal opens pre-filled with the client's name, email, phone, company/legal name, NIT or C.C., address and billing code. Admin modifies fields and submits — PATCH /api/proposals/client-profiles/:id/update/ — modal closes on success. A 400 response surfaces validation errors and keeps the modal open. Successful updates also return the canonical billing_customer projection; new cuentas de cobro use the updated identification, address and legal name while issued documents retain their historical data.

admin-client-email-copy-history.name: Admin Outbound Email Copy Trace
admin-client-email-copy-history.description: Admin expands any primary outbound-email history row and sees every internal BCC recipient, including sent, failed and deduplicated/skipped attempts with independent detail. The primary result remains separate and is not duplicated as another top-level history row.

admin-client-email-copy-settings.name: Admin Client Email Copy Settings
admin-client-email-copy-settings.description: Admin manages the independent universal BCC recipient catalog under /panel/emails?tab=defaults. Each recipient can be added, paused, activated, removed and segmented across proposals, diagnostics, documents/communications, collection accounts, accounting, platform, tasks/operations and security/access. The view explains hidden-copy privacy, security-body visibility and volume impact. Validation and server failures remain visible without claiming a change succeeded.

admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.name: Admin Client Email-Validated Notification
admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.description: When a client confirms their email OTP from the documents portal (POST /api/accounts/email/verify/confirm/), client_flow_notifications fires a team milestone alert (in-app to project admins + email to recipients). Best-effort; already-verified confirmations do not re-notify.
admin-client-email-validated-notificatio.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope; may be asserted as a branch of platform-client-email-validation.

admin-client-first-login-notification.name: Admin Client First-Login Notification
admin-client-first-login-notification.description: When a platform client sets their password and logs in for the first time (POST /api/accounts/verify/, only when was_onboarded was False), client_flow_notifications fires a team milestone alert: an in-app notification to the project admins plus an email to the notification recipients. Best-effort; never blocks onboarding.
admin-client-first-login-notification.knownGaps: Server-triggered side-effect (in-app + email). Out of browser-E2E scope, consistent with the other system-triggered flows; may be asserted as a branch of platform-verify-onboarding.

admin-client-retained-data.name: Consulta de datos sin proyecto del cliente
admin-client-retained-data.description: Desde la ficha expandida de un cliente, Datos sin proyecto abre la consulta de registros conservados de proyectos eliminados. Muestra el nombre de origen y cantidades por categoría; carga detalles al elegir una categoría. Permite volver, paginar y descargar archivos sin editar ni reasignar. Las credenciales se revelan sólo mediante una acción explícita. Un resultado vacío se explica; errores de permisos o del servidor conservan la consulta sin realizar escrituras.

admin-clients-config-tab.name: Admin Clients — Configuraciones Tab
admin-clients-config-tab.description: Admin activates the trailing 'Configuraciones' pill in the clients status-tab row: the list area swaps to the shared ViewSettingsPanel with the client saved-filter-tabs reset (ConfirmModal + POST accounts/saved-filter-tabs/reset/ with view=client, tabs reload on success) and a link to /panel/defaults.

admin-clients-documents-section.name: Admin Clients Documents Section
admin-clients-documents-section.description: The expanded client row (ficha) in /panel/clients lists the client's five most recent active documents — title linking into /panel/documents/<id>/edit, project, status, created date (client-document-row-<id>) — fed by the 'documents' + 'documents_total' keys of the client detail payload. 'Ver todos (N)' (client-documents-all-<id>) jumps into /panel/documents?client=<profileId>, so a client's documents are reachable from their ficha without touching the filters; the relation also works backwards via the document editor's 'Ver cliente' link, which lands here with ?highlight=<profileId> expanding that ficha.

admin-clients-filter-presets.name: Admin Clients Filter Presets
admin-clients-filter-presets.description: Admin reads /panel/clients by business module instead of a flat strip of filters. Level 1 is the module (Todos, Propuestas, Diagnóstico, Proyectos, Hosting, Contabilidad, Documentos, Emails): picking one does NOT narrow the list, it decides which subfilters level 2 offers, which is what lets a module hold both a cut and its complement ('Con hosting cobrado' next to 'Sin hosting'). Level 2 holds the twenty-three subfilters — the seven proposal-status cuts (code-level entries since migration 0049 dropped their seeded rows), 'Con proyecto activo'/'Sin proyecto', the three hosting ones, 'Sin datos de facturacion', and the three Documentos cuts ('Con documentos', 'Sin documentos', 'Con documentos sin proyecto' — the review list the retroactive folder pass leaves behind). Each carries its match count in parentheses, always shown, (0) included, computed over the loaded rows after the status and search cuts, so the number equals what pressing it returns. The hosting and project cuts read the FK-backed aggregates from PA-25 (active_hostings_count / active_projects_count); the Documentos cuts read documents_count / documents_no_project_count (active documents linked via Document.client_user). Selecting a subfilter stamps ?clientTab=<id> and ?clientModule=<module> so the link survives a reload and can be shared; pressing it again clears the cut but stays in the module. Subfilters are values of the filter panel's own controls, so every one of them can also be rebuilt from the panel, combined with each other and with the panel's advanced filters, saved as a named tab under its module, and removed by its chip — which drops the tab highlight with it, since tab, chip and panel are one state. Chips name the module they come from. Whatever does not fit the row moves into a 'Más' menu rather than being clipped. The client status (Todos/Activos/Huerfanos/Inactivos) is transversal: it sits next to the search box, carries its own server-computed counts, travels in ?status= and combines with any module. Deactivated clients stay out by default (the endpoint hides them) even when they still hold live hostings. While the Hosting module is being read each row shows its hosting count, which for superusers doubles as the jump into /panel/accounting/hostings?client=<id>, landing there already filtered; while Documentos is active the row shows '<N> docs · <fecha del último>' (client-documents-<id>, no superuser gate) jumping into /panel/documents?client=<id>. At 412px and 835px only search plus one filter summary precede the first client; status, module, subfilter, advanced filters and view settings live in one bottom drawer in that order. Client rows become stacked summaries with identity, company, email, counts, context and a 44px Actions entry; expanded detail tables become labeled cards and proposal/diagnostic reassignment gains an explicit touch action. From 1195px the two-level tab architecture remains visible, and the page is capped at 1400px on the 2560px monitor.

admin-commercial-video-resources.name: Admin Commercial Video Resources
admin-commercial-video-resources.description: Admin opens resources from Partnership Program settings, Additional Modules, proposal settings or proposal editing; uploads, replaces, removes or restores a video. Validation, failed requests and revision conflicts preserve the current resource.

admin-communication-folders.name: Organización de comunicaciones por carpetas
admin-communication-folders.description: Crear carpetas y subcarpetas por cliente/proyecto, renombrar y mover dentro del contexto, eliminar solo vacías, mover hilos completos y recuperar ubicación desde URL. Errores de validación y servidor conservan el contenido.

admin-daily-pipeline-digest.name: Admin Daily Pipeline Digest
admin-daily-pipeline-digest.description: Daily email digest with viewed yesterday, inactive, and expiring proposals.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

admin-dashboard-attention-radar.name: Admin Dashboard Attention Radar
admin-dashboard-attention-radar.description: Cross-module attention radar on /panel: overdue collection accounts, failed emails, overdue tasks, stale proposals and upcoming recurring payments with severity accents and deep-links; positive empty state when clear.

admin-dashboard-error-retry.name: Admin Dashboard Error Retry
admin-dashboard-error-retry.description: A failed panel/dashboard/ load shows the global error state; the Reintentar button refetches and restores the dashboard.

admin-dashboard-finance-gate.name: Admin Dashboard Finance Gate
admin-dashboard-finance-gate.description: Finance pulse tile and section render only when the payload carries finance data (superuser); staff receive finance: null and see no financial KPIs.

admin-dashboard-pipeline-value.name: Admin Dashboard Pipeline Value
admin-dashboard-pipeline-value.description: Pipeline pulse tile on /panel showing the active pipeline value and count from the consolidated panel/dashboard/ payload; shows a dash when null.

admin-dashboard-quick-create.name: Admin Dashboard Quick Create
admin-dashboard-quick-create.description: Dashboard header "+ Crear" dropdown navigates to create a proposal, document, task or expense.

admin-dashboard-stats-modals.name: Admin Dashboard Stats Modals
admin-dashboard-stats-modals.description: Admin clicks the pulse tiles on /panel to open descriptive-statistics modals. The Pipeline activo tile opens the proposals modal, which lazily fetches GET /api/proposals/dashboard/ once per modal lifetime (heavy endpoint, cached in a local ref, never fetched on dashboard load) and offers tabs Tendencia (stacked trend chart), Embudo (horizontal funnel by status), Valor por etapa (avg value per stage) and Conversión (monthly conversion line + radial close rate). The superuser-gated Utilidad líquida tile opens the finance modal computed client-side from the finance block: Evolución (expected/liquid/expenses area), Utilidad (monthly utility bars + margin strip) and Deuda y compromisos (credit utilization radial + debt/pocket/recurring strip).

admin-dashboard.name: Admin Dashboard
admin-dashboard.description: View the redesigned global admin dashboard: pulse KPIs (liquid utility, active pipeline, attention count), attention radar, and finance / proposals / operations sections fed by GET /api/panel/dashboard/.

admin-defaults-unified.name: Admin Unified Defaults Shell
admin-defaults-unified.description: Admin navigates to /panel/defaults — a unified shell page with a Propuesta/Diagnóstico mode switch. Default mode is proposal. Clicking Diagnóstico updates the URL to ?mode=diagnostic and renders DiagnosticDefaultsPanel. Direct navigation to ?mode=diagnostic lands in diagnostic mode. The back link label changes by mode (Volver a Propuestas / Volver a Diagnósticos). Old routes /panel/proposals/defaults, /panel/proposals/email-templates and /panel/diagnostics/defaults redirect here preserving their mode/tab intent.

admin-diagnostic-activity.name: Admin Diagnostic Activity Timeline
admin-diagnostic-activity.description: Admin records notes / call / meeting / followup events from the Actividad tab (POST /activity/create/). Timeline shows auto-logged events (created, status change, section updated, email sent, accepted, rejected) alongside manual notes.

admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.name: Admin Diagnostic Advanced Filters
admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.description: Admin filters diagnostics from /panel/diagnostics via DiagnosticFilterPanel + ProposalFilterTabs. Default view shows all diagnostics. 'Filtros' toggle opens/closes the filter panel (Estados dimension visible). '+' button creates a named saved-filter tab (persisted to localStorage). Search input filters the card list by title client-side.

admin-diagnostic-analytics.name: Admin Diagnostic Analytics Dashboard
admin-diagnostic-analytics.description: Admin reviews full analytics parity with proposal analytics tab: engagement score (0–100 color-coded), summary KPIs (total views, unique sessions, first view, reading time, coverage, last visit), comparison with global averages, funnel with drop-off %, device breakdown (desktop/mobile/tablet), suggested actions, skipped sections, section heatmap, engagement table, activity timeline, sessions history, and CSV export button. Data sourced from DiagnosticViewEvent + DiagnosticSectionView + DiagnosticChangeLog.

admin-diagnostic-attach-from-documents.name: Admin Diagnostic — Adjuntar desde Documentos
admin-diagnostic-attach-from-documents.description: From the Correos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing: NDA final + draft (if NDA generated), the 3 static MD templates fetched from GET /api/diagnostic-templates/, and any uploaded diagnostic attachments. Admin selects and confirms. Selected refs appear as emerald badges in the composer. On send, POST body includes doc_refs. This flow covers only the selection UX.

admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.name: Admin Diagnostic Bulk Actions
admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.description: Admin selects diagnostics via row/header checkboxes in /panel/diagnostics; a batch bar appears with 'Finalizar aceptados' and 'Eliminar' (confirm modal), calling POST /api/diagnostics/bulk-action/ with {ids, action} and refreshing the list with a result notification. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.spec.js. (Ago 2026) The selection is reconciled against the loaded diagnostics, so deleting a selected row drops it from the batch bar's count instead of leaving a record that no longer exists in it.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-downloa.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Download
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-downloa.description: Admin downloads the final or draft confidentiality PDF from Documents without opening a window or leaving the diagnostic. The browser saves the server filename. Download controls appear only when an agreement exists. Original attachments also download directly; supported previews stay in the existing modal.
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-downloa.knownGaps: NDA-specific E2E error/failure cases are not duplicated here; the shared download controller has HTTP, invalid-response and network tests and the proposal flow exercises recovery in the browser.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-edit.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Edit Params
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-edit.description: Admin re-opens the ConfidentialityParamsModal via 'Editar parámetros' on a diagnostic that already has a generated NDA. Form pre-fills from diagnostic.confidentiality_params. Admin modifies one or more fields and submits — the existing DiagnosticAttachment file is replaced in place (same row id, file.delete + file.save, single .save() call). Section header still shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with the updated timestamp.

admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-generat.name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Generate
admin-diagnostic-confidentiality-generat.description: Admin generates the Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (NDA) PDF from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Section displays 'No generado' with a 'Generar acuerdo' CTA when no NDA exists. CTA opens ConfidentialityParamsModal with 13 fields (cliente: nombre/NIT/representante/email; consultor: nombre/NIT/cédula/email — defaults to Project App SAS / team@projectapp.co; acuerdo: ciudad — default Medellín, día/mes/año, cláusula penal — default 50 SMMLV). The consultor must be identified by NIT or cédula — at least one is required client-side and by ConfidentialityParamsSerializer; the NIT wins when both are present. Submit posts to POST /api/diagnostics/:id/confidentiality/params/, which validates via ConfidentialityParamsSerializer, persists to diagnostic.confidentiality_params, and creates a DiagnosticAttachment with document_type='confidentiality_agreement' and is_generated=true. Section then shows 'Generado el {fecha}' with Descargar / Borrador / Editar parámetros buttons.

admin-diagnostic-create.name: Admin Diagnostic Create
admin-diagnostic-create.description: Admin creates a new WebAppDiagnostic from /panel/diagnostics/create: searches for a client via autocomplete, selects language, submits → redirected to edit page with 8 JSON sections seeded from the default template.

admin-diagnostic-defaults-config.name: Admin Diagnostic Defaults Config
admin-diagnostic-defaults-config.description: Admin manages the per-language default config applied to new WebAppDiagnostic rows from /panel/diagnostics/defaults/. The General tab edits language, currency, default investment amount, default duration label, payment percentages (auto-synced to sum 100, default 60/40), and reminder/urgency/expiration days. Save PUTs /api/diagnostics/defaults/?lang= and the response is applied directly (no refetch). Reset opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /defaults/reset/ to delete the row, falling back to the hardcoded seed. Sections, Plantillas de Email (link), Prompt (placeholder) and JSON tabs render from the same config payload.

admin-diagnostic-delete.name: Admin Diagnostic Delete
admin-diagnostic-delete.description: Admin deletes an existing WebAppDiagnostic from the diagnostics list or edit page via confirm modal. DELETE /api/diagnostics/:id/delete/.

admin-diagnostic-document-preview.name: Admin Diagnostic Document Preview
admin-diagnostic-document-preview.description: From the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page, admin clicks the eye icon next to an attachment. A modal opens previewing the file inline — PDF (rendered in iframe) or image (via tag), gated by frontend/utils/filePreview.js (canPreviewFile). Non-previewable files keep only the existing download action. Replaces the previous inline template-expand behavior on DiagnosticDocumentsTab.
knownGaps: Eye-icon preview modal replaced inline template-expand in DiagnosticDocumentsTab.vue on 2026-04-26 (commit 9877df24). Component-level unit test exists (DiagnosticDocumentsTab.spec.js); E2E spec pending.

admin-diagnostic-documents.name: Admin Diagnostic Attachment Management
admin-diagnostic-documents.description: Admin uploads, manages, and sends file attachments (PDF, Word, Excel, images) from the Documentos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Checkbox selection enables the send-to-client button. The send section also exposes a checkbox for the system-generated Acuerdo de Confidencialidad (when present) which is appended to the email as a watermarked draft. System-generated attachments (is_generated=true) cannot be deleted — DELETE returns HTTP 400; this backend protection is defensive only since the UI filters generated NDAs out of the deletable list.
knownGaps: is_generated delete-blocked branch is backend-only (UI offers no delete button for generated NDAs); covered by backend tests, not E2E.

admin-diagnostic-edit.name: Admin Diagnostic Edit
admin-diagnostic-edit.description: Admin edits top-level metadata of an existing WebAppDiagnostic from the General tab: title, client (via ClientAutocomplete) + client-snapshot fields (name/email/phone/company) + propagate-to-profile checkbox, language, investment amount + currency, payment terms (initial/final pct), duration label, and size category. Changes are saved via PATCH /api/diagnostics/:id/update/. Radiografía data is edited as a regular section from the Secciones tab. Section content is edited separately under admin-diagnostic-sections; full-JSON round-trip lives under admin-diagnostic-json-export / admin-diagnostic-json-import.

admin-diagnostic-email.name: Admin Diagnostic Email Composer
admin-diagnostic-email.description: Admin sends one follow-up branded email from the Correos tab of a diagnostic to multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients. The shared hybrid picker starts with the diagnostic client, searches registered clients or accepts manual addresses, and enforces 10 unique destinations. The composer also includes subject, draggable Markdown sections, footer, attachments and real-template preview. The NDA branch generates the confidentiality PDF. History groups the delivery while retaining each address status.

admin-diagnostic-engagement-score.name: Admin Diagnostic Engagement Score
admin-diagnostic-engagement-score.description: Engagement score card renders with correct color-coded level label: Alto engagement (≥70), Engagement moderado (40–69), Bajo engagement (<40). Card hidden when engagement_score is null.

admin-diagnostic-filters.name: Admin Diagnostic Filters
admin-diagnostic-filters.description: Filter diagnostics using saved tabs with localStorage persistence and URL sync (?tab=<tabId>). Filter dimensions: statuses (multi-select), investmentMin/Max, createdAfter/Before. Tab bar supports add/rename/delete (max 12 tabs).
admin-diagnostic-filters.knownGaps: Own-tag tests added 2026-07-23 (round 6): status dimension filtering, Limpiar todo reset and diagnosticTab URL sync, inside admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.spec.js.

admin-diagnostic-json-export.name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Export
admin-diagnostic-json-export.description: Admin opens the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit. A read-only textarea renders the full diagnostic serialized as JSON (metadata + sections). Actualizar refetches /detail/ from the server; Copiar writes the current text to the clipboard; Descargar streams a {slug}.json Blob download. The string is lazy-computed from store.current so it rebuilds only when the tab is rendered.

admin-diagnostic-json-import.name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Import
admin-diagnostic-json-import.description: Admin imports a JSON blob from the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit, either by pasting into the textarea or uploading a .json file (FileReader → textarea). Parse runs on every input; validation requires a root object with an array `sections`. A preview strip shows client name, section count, and formatted investment. Aplicar JSON runs PATCH /update/ for metadata first, then POST /sections/bulk-update/; success emits an inline toast and resyncs the pricing/radiography forms. Errors surface inline and abort the apply.

admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.name: Admin Diagnostic List — Load Error & Retry
admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.description: When GET /api/diagnostics/ fails, the list page shows a dedicated error state (data-testid=diagnostics-error-state) with the normalized Spanish error message and a 'Reintentar' button that re-fires the fetch; an error notification is also raised via usePanelNotify. Distinct from the empty state. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-list-error-retry.spec.js.

admin-diagnostic-list.name: Admin Diagnostic List
admin-diagnostic-list.description: Admin views the list of all WebAppDiagnostics, searches by client name or title, and navigates to create or edit flows.

admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis.name: Admin Diagnostic Mark In Analysis
admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis.description: Admin clicks 'Marcar en análisis' on a SENT diagnostic to acknowledge that the client authorized continuing — opens a ConfirmModal and POSTs /api/diagnostics/:id/mark-in-analysis/, transitioning SENT → NEGOTIATING. The button is only available after `initial_sent_at` is set; afterwards the 'Enviar diagnóstico final' action becomes the next user step.

admin-diagnostic-markdown-attachment.name: Diagnostic Email — Markdown to PDF Attachment
admin-diagnostic-markdown-attachment.description: When a diagnostic is in 'negotiating' status, admin sees a 'Crear documento desde markdown' button in the Correos tab. Clicking it opens MarkdownAttachmentModal, which takes a title, a markdown textarea, and three cover-toggle checkboxes. A 'Plantillas base' row provides three copy-to-clipboard buttons (Diagnóstico de Aplicación / Diagnóstico Técnico / Anexo) that fetch GET /api/diagnostic-templates/:slug/ on first click and write the markdown to the clipboard; subsequent clicks use an in-memory cache. The Vista previa button is disabled until both title and markdown are filled; clicking it POSTs to POST /api/diagnostics/:id/email/markdown-attachment/ (returns an inline PDF). The PDF is rendered in an iframe for review. Clicking Adjuntar converts the blob to a File and emits @attach — appending it to the email attachments list with a success toast.

admin-diagnostic-prompt.name: Admin Diagnostic Prompt Editor
admin-diagnostic-prompt.description: Admin copies / edits / downloads the two diagnostic prompts (commercial and technical) from the Prompt tab. State is persisted in localStorage per browser via usePromptState({storageKey, defaultPrompt}).

admin-diagnostic-sections.name: Admin Diagnostic Sections Editor
admin-diagnostic-sections.description: Admin edits the 8 JSON sections from the Secciones tab of the diagnostic edit page. Each section type has a typed form (paragraphs, severity levels, 14-category findings, radiography table, timeline rows, etc.). Changes are debounced and PATCHed to /sections/<id>/update/. The tab also exposes a completeness indicator (% + colored progress bar counting enabled sections with non-empty content_json) and a per-section 'Restaurar contenido por defecto' action (POST /sections/<id>/reset/). Raw-JSON read + bulk apply moved to the JSON tab — see admin-diagnostic-json-export / admin-diagnostic-json-import.

admin-diagnostic-send-final.name: Admin Diagnostic Send Final
admin-diagnostic-send-final.description: Admin sends the final-phase diagnostic from NEGOTIATING via 'Enviar diagnóstico final' (SENT again, final_sent_at stamped). Public view now also exposes sections with visibility ∈ {final}. Gated by the same pre-send scorecard modal as send-initial.

admin-diagnostic-send-initial.name: Admin Diagnostic Send Initial
admin-diagnostic-send-initial.description: Admin sends the initial-phase diagnostic from the edit page via 'Enviar envío inicial' — POST /api/diagnostics/:id/send-initial/, stamps `initial_sent_at`, status moves DRAFT → SENT. Public view then exposes only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both}. The follow-up SENT → NEGOTIATING transition is its own flow (`admin-diagnostic-mark-in-analysis`). Since the Jul 2026 UX redesign the send opens a pre-send scorecard modal (GET /api/diagnostics/:id/scorecard/): blockers disable the send button and the backend refuses to transition while blockers remain (400 scorecard_blockers).

admin-discount-analysis-enhanced.name: Admin Discount Analysis Enhanced
admin-discount-analysis-enhanced.description: Enhanced discount card with sample sizes, avg discount %, and delta warning.

admin-document-archive.name: Admin Document Archive
admin-document-archive.description: Admin archives documents and folders from /panel/documents, where WHERE (activeFolderId: all | root | none | <id>) and IN WHICH STATE (scope: active | archived | all, default active) are independent axes. The actions sheet offers 'Archivar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/archive/) and, on an archived document, 'Restaurar' (PATCH /api/documents/:id/unarchive/), whose response reports in `restored_chain` the container folders the backend had to reopen so the document lands somewhere reachable. Each sidebar folder row carries an archive icon (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/archive/, cascading over subfolders and documents and reporting the counts, behind a confirmation showing the inventory) and a delete icon that is DISABLED whenever the folder holds anything, archived content included, matching the backend 409; both name their action in a tooltip. The delete confirmation for a document still offers archiving as a secondary action, visible and enabled BEFORE the DELETE word is typed. 'Ver documentos archivados' is an explicit MODE SWITCH in the sidebar header, deliberately OUTSIDE the folder list: as a row among the folders it read as one more destination, and nothing declared that the archive is the scope the whole panel is being seen in. Turning it on from Todos lands on the archive root and turning it off from there returns to Todos; from inside a folder it only changes the state, keeping the user where they were. The archive renders as a NAVIGABLE TREE — an archived folder appears as a container, its cascade-archived children are reached by entering it (GET /api/documents/?folder=:id&scope=archived) and the breadcrumb reads 'Archivados › …'. An active folder that still holds archived items shows a badge that opens it in its archived scope. A three-way state filter (Todos / Solo activos / Solo archivados) sits in the toolbar and applies to folders and documents alike; the archived scope keeps its Archivado column and relative age while the shared date icon orders archived_at in both directions through ?order=oldest. Search is global — it ignores folder and state (GET /api/documents/?scope=all&search=), visibly moves the filter to Todos, marks each archived hit and applies the same order to each row's displayed date — and every mutation refreshes the authoritative sidebar counters from GET /api/documents/counts/. Archived items are not drop targets and cannot be dragged. View-sync wave (2026-08-13): archiving or deleting the folder being viewed — or any ancestor of it — retreats the view to the affected folder's parent (fallback Todos) instead of leaving a ghost descendant; selecting a folder or clicking a mixed-state badge DURING a search exits the search and actually navigates (the badge lands in that folder's archived scope); the search shows the list skeleton while in flight and clears stale results on each new term; inside an archived folder an inline alert offers 'Restaurar esta carpeta' (doc-restore-current-folder) and following the restore switches the view to the active scope keeping the folder; folder and scope persist in the URL (?folder=&scope=, router.replace, defaults omitted, transient search scope never persisted) so F5 and deep links rebuild the view; 'Sin carpeta' shows the unfiled_active counter; archive/delete confirmations spin in-flight (waitForConfirm keeps ConfirmModal open and busy) and row Restaurar buttons go inert while a mutation runs. Declared-mode wave (2026-08-15): the scope is labelled in the listing header (doc-scope-banner) whenever it is not the resting one, and the section carries its own tint in archived mode; the sidebar FOLLOWS the mode — it lists the real root folders, so a fully archived folder no longer looks like it stopped existing, and Todos, Sin carpeta and every folder row count what the current mode shows (archived / unfiled_archived); the single-highlight rule is gone, so the folder being viewed lights up again with aria-current=page, archive included; a folder holding nothing archived says so by name instead of falling into the generic empty, and with the mode off an archived folder no longer offers 'create a document here', which the backend rejects with a 400; the URL is authoritative in BOTH directions (a missing param means the default, so a store left over from a previous visit cannot survive a return to the module, and back/forward reapply to the view); and deleting or moving a document leaves the view in the folder it was in, the same rule archiving already followed. Scope-fidelity wave (2026-08-31): the archived mode lists a folder only when it is archived itself or still holds archived content in its subtree — a project with nothing archived disappears entirely instead of showing its whole active tree — and every listed row counts its inventory in the VIEW's scope, not in its own state.
admin-document-archive.knownGaps: Spec extended 2026-08-13 with the view-sync wave: sidebar lit in archived scope at depth, ancestor-archive retreating to the top, badge-mid-search exiting into the archived folder, restore-current-folder following into the active scope, and URL persistence surviving a reload. Still covered only at the backend layer: the cascade-memory rule (items archived individually stay archived when their folder is unarchived), the chain restore leaving the rest of those folders archived, the guards that reject moving or duplicating active content into an archived folder, the audit_archive_integrity command, and the client portal now excluding archived documents (accounts tests).

admin-document-change-history.name: Admin Document Change History
admin-document-change-history.description: Abre Historial desde el detalle del documento; consulta versiones completas y campos modificados, compara dos versiones o la anterior, invierte el orden y pagina. El historial presenta fecha, autor, origen y cambios; carga 20 entradas por página. Evidencia antigua incompleta no se puede comparar. Errores de carga, consulta o comparación permiten reintentar.

admin-document-create.name: Admin Document Create
admin-document-create.description: Create a new admin document via Markdown paste mode or file upload mode, with title, a full-width Markdown editor whose Editar/Vista previa switch renders the preview in the editor's own box, and optional private notes opened from doc-client-note-open. Because no document exists yet, the modal labels its action Aplicar al borrador, keeps it in a fixed bar that enables only once a note changes, and explains before and after submission that creation is still required; the later create request persists every note without adding it to the PDF. The optional client/project association remains available through ClientAutocomplete plus ProjectSelect, including inverse project-to-client cascade and folder suggestions. The folder is chosen with DocumentFolderSelect (doc-folder-select): a search over name, path, client and project whose rows show location, owner and a non-active project state; automatic folders are never offered, the chosen one shows its full path, its ✕ retracts an inherited client, a ?folder= link to an automatic or archived folder proposes the nearest manual ancestor with a notice, and a failed folder read says so and offers Reintentar. Crear Documento stays available: an attempt without title or content shows each requirement under its field (paste and file modes), marks the control invalid and focuses the first one without calling the API; a 400 on title or markdown lands on its field while other rejections keep the notification. Cancelar and Crear Documento share one right-aligned action row with no validation text.
admin-document-create.knownGaps: Cover toggles and template-style selection are carried by the same payload but are not asserted independently in this flow.

admin-document-delete.name: Admin Document Delete
admin-document-delete.description: Admin deletes a document from the actions sheet: 'Eliminar' opens ConfirmModal; confirming sends DELETE /api/documents/:id/delete/ and removes the row/card; cancelling keeps it. Current list spec only asserts the button is visible.
admin-document-delete.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): happy path + cancel/error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-drag-organize.name: Admin Document Drag Organize
admin-document-drag-organize.description: Admin organizes by drag-and-drop: dragging a document card/row onto a sidebar folder moves it (PATCH /api/documents/:id/update/ folder_id), and dragging a folder onto a breadcrumb/sidebar folder re-parents it (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/). The modal-based move path is covered by admin-document-move-folder; the drag path is not.
admin-document-drag-organize.knownGaps: Drag interactions untested (fragile in Playwright; needs dispatchEvent-based DnD). Registered 2026-07-16 audit.

admin-document-duplicate.name: Admin Document Duplicate
admin-document-duplicate.description: Admin duplicates a document from the actions sheet: 'Duplicar' sends POST /api/documents/:id/duplicate/ and the copy appears in the list.
admin-document-duplicate.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (round 7): duplicate POST with the copy appearing in the refreshed list, plus the error-toast branch.

admin-document-edit.name: Admin Document Edit
admin-document-edit.description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; explicit exits restore that context, while direct or untrusted origins fall back safely. A discreet `Documentos / ...` path under the title exposes every real folder ancestor as a hoverable link back to that folder, including the root and unassigned locations. Moving the document uses the same DocumentFolderSelect as the create form (doc-folder-select): a search over name, path, client and project that shows the current folder's full path, never offers automatic folders, and sends the new folder_id on save. The responsive header clamps long titles, keeps portal visibility and client metadata independent, and shows concurrent state episodes with their duration. The Acciones menu remains separate from the non-wrapping Cancelar/Guardar pair. The compact notes entry opens a wide modal whose message fields grow with their content and whose Cancelar/Guardar cambios pair stays in a fixed bar, enabled only once a message changes; it performs an immediate notes-only PATCH for client messages and legacy custom notes, leaving unrelated page edits pending; normalized observations use the audited state workflow and may link to needs-fix. Failed saves keep the modal draft open. Stored commercial-proposal versions and issued collection accounts open as immutable PDF records: identity, association, folder, messages and workflow controls are read-only, the exact archived PDF is previewed and downloaded once, and private observations remain manageable. The three contract mirrors (combined, product and service) stay in Contratos, open through list navigation with version and synchronization date, preview the current draft PDF, export PDF or Markdown, and offer no editor, save, rename, move, duplicate, archive, delete or drag. Markdown tools, the full-width editor with its Editar/Vista previa switch (the preview takes the editor's own box at document reading width), contained template previews with bounded scrolling and dual PDF download remain available only for editable Markdown documents.

admin-document-email-history.name: Admin Navigates Document Email Usage
admin-document-email-history.description: Admin opens a document from the Documents list, sees the exact emails where it was attached and follows one usage link to the corresponding expanded row in the universal email history.

admin-document-folder-change-client.name: Admin Document Folder Change Client
admin-document-folder-change-client.description: Reassigning a folder's client when it already holds content. The plain PATCH refuses with 409 `folder_has_content` and FolderFormModal raises the conflict instead of swallowing it, so the guided cascade takes over: GET /api/document-folders/:id/change-client/preview/?client_profile_id= names every bucket — the subfolders and documents that move, the issued cuentas de cobro that are never rewritten, and whatever was deliberately assigned to a third client (a subfolder of another client prunes its whole branch) — then the operator picks a mode EVERY time (Pasa también el contenido | Sólo la carpeta, no preselection) and POST /api/document-folders/:id/change-client/ carries the preview's document_ids/folder_ids back as a staleness token, so a 409 records_not_found/records_changed reloads the plan instead of guessing. Clearing the client is deliberately NOT routed here: "nobody" is not a destination the cascade can express, so unassigning a folder is a plain PATCH that leaves its content alone.
admin-document-folder-change-client.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-08-16 with the folder client/project feature: the 409 handoff, the preview buckets, the mode gate and the staleness token over a mocked API.

admin-document-folder-hierarchy.name: Admin Document Folder Hierarchy
admin-document-folder-hierarchy.description: Navigate nested document folders: root-only sidebar, subfolder rows inside the table, breadcrumb navigation above the table, and drag-to-nest re-parenting of manual folders. System-managed branches created for generated documents remain navigable through project/type/year/month but hide edit, archive, delete, drag and manual-drop affordances.

admin-document-folder-manage.name: Admin Document Folder Management
admin-document-folder-manage.description: Admin manages folders in FolderManagerModal: create folder with parent selector (POST /api/document-folders/create/), inline rename (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/), delete with confirmation (DELETE /api/document-folders/:id/delete/) and drag-reorder (POST /api/document-folders/reorder/). Existing admin-document-folders spec only covers parent pre-selection on create. The sidebar (FolderSidebar) also exposes a per-row trash icon, enabled on every folder: it opens DeleteFolderModal, which lists the folder inventory. On an empty folder the modal requires typing DELETE (case-sensitive) before confirming and offers archiving alongside; on a folder that still holds content it drops the destructive button entirely and presents archiving as the available action. The folder manager's own delete icon delegates to that same modal, so folder deletion has one contract everywhere.
admin-document-folder-manage.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): create/rename/delete + documents-blocking branch over mocked API. Drag-reorder intentionally not asserted (flaky in CI). Sidebar delete (DELETE-typed confirm, blocked icon, 409 conflict) added 2026-08-04. Rewritten 2026-08-11: the blocked-icon branch is gone (a filled folder now reaches the modal and is offered archiving), and the manager's inline confirmation panel was consolidated into DeleteFolderModal.

admin-document-folder-panel-resize.name: Admin Document Folder Panel Resize
admin-document-folder-panel-resize.description: Resize the /panel/documents folder sidebar: the default width (384px) fits the real longest folder names (22 characters, live inventory of 2026-08-16) untruncated even on the active font-medium row; a keyboard-accessible drag handle (role=separator) in the gap between the panel and the documents view resizes between 240px and 480px, persisting to localStorage (projectapp-documents-folder-width) on drag end; double-click resets to the default and clears the stored value; below lg the panel stacks full width, the handle does not render and the stored width does not apply.

admin-document-folders.name: Admin Document Folders
admin-document-folders.description: Organize admin documents through the independent Carpetas propias section. Only operator-created roots with no project and no client appear there; assigned client roots and system-managed project roots stay in their entity catalogs. Own roots keep navigation, recursive inventory, rename, archive, delete and reorder behavior regardless of whether entity navigation is grouped by project or client. Managed project roots remain valid parents in the folder manager. The 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' selector defaults to the currently active own folder. Project/client grouping is covered separately by admin-document-navigation; document state filtering remains an independent axis covered by admin-document-state-filters.

admin-document-gallery.name: Admin Document Gallery View
admin-document-gallery.description: Toggle between list and gallery views on /panel/documents via the 'Lista'/'Galería' segmented control (data-testid doc-view-list / doc-view-grid). Gallery renders one card per document with a sanitized markdown mini-preview, client and date, ordered active-state episodes with open durations and a +N overflow badge, plus the same kebab action opening DocumentActionsSheet. That action keeps the contextual accessible name Acciones de <title>, omits the native title and exposes exactly one short application tooltip, Acciones. Subfolder cards render first with dashed borders and act as drag-and-drop targets. The chosen mode persists in localStorage; on mobile the gallery is always used.

admin-document-list.name: Admin Document List
admin-document-list.description: View admin documents in the fixed business column order Actions, Title, States, Created, Client and Project. The table requests server-owned pages of 10 rows and the grid requests 12; the authoritative range and total appear in pagination, ?page restores the same cut, and changing folder, project, filters, search, order or presentation requests the matching server page. Rapid navigation cancels the superseded request so an older folder cannot repaint the latest selection. Created is the only sortable column: it opens newest-first, toggles both date directions from an accessible icon, serializes only the non-default ?order=oldest value and keeps that value across filters, folders, scope, search and presentation changes. Archived rows sort by archived_at, active rows by created_at and mixed/search results use the date each row displays. Gallery and compact layouts expose the same date direction through a toolbar control because they have no column header. Ordinary documents show workflow episodes; collection accounts instead show their derived commercial state (Borrador, Emitida, Enviada, Envío fallido, Pagada or Anulada), and issued accounts expose only read-only viewing, one accounting PDF download and archive/restore actions. The exclusive cycle appears before additive signals, every badge carries its open duration, Solucionar bug is visually prominent, overflow collapses to +N, and documents with no cycle show Por clasificar. The kebab action keeps the contextual accessible name Acciones de <title>, omits the native title and exposes exactly one short application tooltip, Acciones, before opening the row menu. Landscape keeps Title, States, Created and Actions as columns while grouping Client/Project under Title; compact cards keep Title/States primary and order secondary metadata as Created, Client, Project. Filters and episode behavior are covered by admin-document-state-filters and admin-document-state-workflow.

admin-document-move-folder.name: Admin Document Move Folder
admin-document-move-folder.description: Admin moves editable documents to a folder or root. Compact write responses preserve the editor. The three contract mirrors stay in Contratos and reject all moves.

admin-document-navigation.name: Admin Document Project Client Navigation
admin-document-navigation.description: Admin recorre el gestor documental por proyecto o por cliente con el mismo interruptor de Comunicaciones. El catálogo operativo aparece por defecto; un control local y excluyente cambia el catálogo por el de no activos y retira los activos mientras está encendido; gobierna los DOS modos («Ver proyectos no activos» / «Ver clientes archivados»), así que un cliente archivado sale de la vista igual que un proyecto suspendido. Ese eje es independiente de «Ver documentos archivados», que filtra el contenido documental y vive junto a Carpetas propias. Cualquiera de los dos giros del control devuelve a Todos una selección que deja de listarse. La selección acota el listado y limpia el eje incompatible. Al descender por una carpeta perteneciente a la entidad, conserva esa selección y el editor devuelve a la misma carpeta con la entidad todavía activa; sólo una carpeta propia o ajena limpia proyecto y cliente. El modo elegido se guarda por cuenta y la sección Carpetas propias contiene sólo raíces sin proyecto ni cliente. La conciliación se mantiene como operación interna y no interrumpe la navegación con avisos técnicos. Un fallo de las facetas conserva operables esas carpetas y ofrece reintento.

admin-document-observation-delete.name: Admin Document Observation Deletion
admin-document-observation-delete.description: Admin distinguishes discarding a real observation from deleting one that never should have existed. Deletion always shows the complete observation and an external-copy warning, uses recoverable soft deletion for any status, removes deleted rows from active counts, reconciles the last note-origin pending state, supports one atomic bulk request, exposes a trash restore action, and shows actor/time-only audit activity without copying deleted content.

admin-document-pdf-download.name: Admin Document PDF Download
admin-document-pdf-download.description: Admin downloads a Document entity as a branded PDF from the edit header's document-level 'Acciones' menu, choosing 'Descargar PDF · Amigable' or 'Descargar PDF · Profesional'. The file is built server-side from the SAVED document, so the export options — las casillas de portada, subportada y contraportada — only reach the PDF once saved: a line under the checkboxes (data-testid doc-included-pages) names, live, the pages the PDF will bring, and downloading with pending changes opens the three-way confirmation 'Guardar y descargar' / 'Descargar lo guardado' / 'Seguir editando' instead of silently shipping the previous configuration.

admin-document-pdf-preview.name: Admin Document PDF Preview
admin-document-pdf-preview.description: Admin previews the generated PDF from the document edit page ('Previsualizar PDF', data-testid doc-preview-pdf) instead of downloading it to find out how it came out. The viewer embeds the very file the download delivers — same endpoint with ?inline=1 — so the portada, subportada and contraportada decided by the export checkboxes are visible before downloading; its header (doc-pdf-preview-pages) names the pages of the SAVED configuration, and previewing with pending changes offers 'Guardar y previsualizar' / 'Previsualizar lo guardado' / 'Seguir editando'.

admin-document-rename.name: Admin Document Rename
admin-document-rename.description: Admin renames a document from the actions sheet: 'Renombrar' opens RenameDocumentModal with the current title, saving sends PATCH /api/documents/:id/update/ and the list refreshes with the new title.
admin-document-rename.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 2): happy path + cancel/error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-send-email.name: Admin Document Send Email
admin-document-send-email.description: Admin sends one branded email with document PDFs attached from the documents list to multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients selected from registered clients or entered manually (10 unique addresses total). The actions sheet opens SendDocumentEmailModal, which posts recipient_emails, cc_emails and document_ids to /api/emails/send/. After delivery, an in-modal step offers to open Enviado episodes with origin=email; declining that optional transition does not undo the email.
admin-document-send-email.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign): happy path, 429 rate-limited and generic-error branches over mocked API.

admin-document-state-filters.name: Admin Document State Filters
admin-document-state-filters.description: Admin scans current state episodes and their open duration in the document list, where Solucionar bug is visually prominent. Multi-select state values are ORed, absence queries find documents without Cerrado, and presets cover needs-fix, sent-not-closed, closed and unclassified inventories. A failed filtered request leaves a persistent retryable error.

admin-document-state-workflow.name: Admin Document State Episodes
admin-document-state-workflow.description: Admin manages concurrent document-state episodes from the editor. Exclusive cycle states transition in either direction while additive signals coexist; each opening, close, removal and corrected effective date remains attributable in the timeline. Inline creation first suggests similar shared states. Closing or removing a state uses a contextual in-panel modal with an optional reason. Normalized observations can open Solucionar bug and automatically close or remove that linked episode when the last pending observation is resolved, discarded or deleted.

admin-document-states-manage.name: Admin Document States Management
admin-document-states-manage.description: Admin opens /panel/documents/statuses from the document list to manage the shared state catalog: inspect active-document and historical-episode counts, create reusable states and groups, rename/recolor/reorder them, define incompatibilities, merge duplicates, and retire unused values without deleting history. Similar-name, merge and retirement decisions use contextual in-panel confirmation modals. Create state, create group, save and merge stay available: an attempt without a name or merge target shows the requirement under its field and marks it invalid, serializer field errors land on their field, and a seed state keeps a disabled merge with accessible help.

admin-document-thread.name: Admin Document Thread
admin-document-thread.description: El administrador enlaza documentos en una historia lineal independiente de carpetas, clientes y proyectos. El modal se abre desde la lista o el editor y ofrece Relacionar, Detalle y Cronología; permite buscar metadatos, incluir archivados, editar la fecha de cada hito y consultar markdown o PDF. Cada documento pertenece como máximo a un hilo, y todo candidato bloqueado se explica: el ocupado por otro hilo nombra ese hilo y su tamaño, y el ya agregado al borrador lo dice también. El orden usa la fecha de negocio con posición estable, archivar conserva la relación y eliminar exige retirar primero el documento. Un hilo requiere dos documentos: si una edición deja sólo uno, se disuelve tras confirmación. El índice de hilos los enumera con búsqueda, orden y rango de fechas, y abre cada uno por su primer miembro; en la lista y el editor el badge Hilo · N también abre el hilo, mientras una copia duplicada nace independiente.

admin-document-title-column-resize.name: Admin Document Title Column Resize
admin-document-title-column-resize.description: Read long document names without opening them in /panel/documents. In both the table and card gallery, titles are contained on one ellipsized line; when clipping is confirmed, including after web fonts finish loading, one app-owned floating hint shows the complete text and the same in-place Ver completo/Contraer control provides the touch path, whose expanded state wraps even unbroken names. The hint reuses the viewport-aware BaseTooltip primitive used by row actions, without a duplicate native title; brief action labels stay on one horizontal line and remain inside the viewport. Folder and accompanying distinctions render in ordered metadata below the title without reserving a blank desktop line for documents without a folder. In list mode, the Título header exposes a visible, labelled and keyboard-accessible drag separator that resizes from 240px to the inventory-backed 520px maximum, starts at 320px, persists the chosen width in projectapp-table-widths:documents-list, and resets on double-click. Proyecto, Cliente and Fecha yield space in that order, while Estados and Acciones remain fixed and the table scrolls internally after donor floors are reached.

admin-document-unsaved-guard.name: Admin Document Unsaved Changes Guard
admin-document-unsaved-guard.description: Unsaved-changes protection on the document editor and creator. Editing any tracked field raises a permanent warning (data-testid doc-unsaved-notice / doc-create-unsaved-notice) whose title names the pending fields — 'Cliente y proyecto sin guardar' — instead of saying only that something is pending; past three fields it counts them and lists them in a detail line. Per-field 'Sin guardar' badges mark título, cliente and proyecto inside the sticky aside (doc-field-dirty-title / -client / -project). Leaving the page, or pressing the global 'Actualizar datos' refresh button, opens a three-way confirmation: 'Guardar y salir' (primary, runs the PATCH and only then navigates — a failed save keeps the user on the page), 'Salir sin guardar' (secondary) and 'Seguir editando' (cancel). An issued cuenta de cobro drops the save exit, since the backend refuses it with collection_account_locked. A pristine form shows no warning and the editor's single responsive save button (doc-save) stays disabled, a create form opened with ?folder= is not born dirty despite the folder's client suggestion and the folder picker resolving its path, and typing in the client or folder picker without committing a choice does not manufacture a warning.

admin-email-deliverability.name: Admin Email Deliverability Dashboard
admin-email-deliverability.description: Dashboard tracking email send/delivery/bounce rates for all proposal-related automated emails. Accessible from /panel/proposals/email-deliverability.

admin-email-templates-config.name: Admin Email Templates Config
admin-email-templates-config.description: Manage email template text customization with category filter, inline editing, HTML preview, active toggle, and reset to defaults.

admin-financing-agreement-create.name: Admin Financing Agreement Create
admin-financing-agreement-create.description: El administrador abre el registro, selecciona un cliente activo, revisa su identidad y completa contrato, alcance y valores. Al elegir cinco años ve la exclusividad conceptual y la ayuda para delimitar sector, nicho y producto; al cambiar a tres años ese compromiso se excluye. Crea el borrador con el calendario definido por la política vigente.

admin-financing-agreement-lifecycle.name: Admin Financing Agreement Lifecycle
admin-financing-agreement-lifecycle.description: Admin manages a financing addendum from draft to ready, explicitly adopts the current policy in an older draft, downloads the watermarked populated draft, registers the signed PDF in private storage, certifies full payment or cancellation, and archives or restores terminal records while the audit history remains visible.

admin-financing-agreement-second-cycle.name: Admin Financing Agreement Second Cycle
admin-financing-agreement-second-cycle.description: After the first five-year financing cycle is certified as fully paid, admin performs the manual risk approval that creates one new twelve-month draft; the second cycle keeps the original five-year exclusivity dates and is unavailable to three-year agreements or duplicate attempts.

admin-financing-distribution.name: Admin Financing Distribution
admin-financing-distribution.description: Admin navigates from Comercial to the financing module, copies or opens the canonical URL, downloads the PDF, previews the public content and can retry a failed load.

admin-financing-explainer-visibility.name: Admin Partnership Program Explainer Visibility
admin-financing-explainer-visibility.description: Admin shows or hides the Partnership Program explainer video for clients from the switch on the Programa tab; the change is confirmed, and a failed save puts the switch back with an error.

admin-financing-explainer.name: Admin Financing Explainer
admin-financing-explainer.description: Admin previews the financing explainer video from the compact card on the Programa tab; the public preview below does not repeat it. Playback starts only after a click, pauses when the page or window loses activity, and never resumes automatically on return.

admin-financing-settings.name: Admin Financing Settings
admin-financing-settings.description: Admin reviews the current immutable financing policy and its history, edits the eligible COP range, financing term, financed percentage, overdue Hosting increase, and installment window, then confirms publication of a new revision used by public content and future drafts.

admin-high-engagement-alert.name: Admin High Engagement Alert
admin-high-engagement-alert.description: System creates high_engagement_today alert when client has 3+ view sessions in one day.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

admin-hour-packages-config.name: Admin Hour Packages — Configuración
admin-hour-packages-config.description: Admin opens the Configuración section of /panel/hour-packages: edits the per-nationality base hourly rates (COL/EXT/USA) and saves — PATCH /api/hour-packages/admin/settings/update/ propagates the rate to every package of that nationality and the catalog reflects it; invalid rates (<= 0) are rejected client-side and a server failure surfaces an error toast. Also saves the default view mode and restores one nationality's catalog to the canonical DEFAULT_PACKAGES ladder behind a ConfirmModal (POST /api/hour-packages/admin/restore-defaults/, destructive replace; restore also resets that nationality's base rate).

admin-hour-packages-create.name: Admin Hour Packages Create
admin-hour-packages-create.description: Create an hour package with nationality, bilingual names, hours, rate and discount; currency derives from nationality.

admin-hour-packages-delete.name: Admin Hour Packages Delete
admin-hour-packages-delete.description: Delete an hour package with confirmation modal.

admin-hour-packages-edit.name: Admin Hour Packages Edit
admin-hour-packages-edit.description: Edit an existing hour package and verify the computed effective rate/total preview.

admin-hour-packages-list.name: Admin Hour Packages List
admin-hour-packages-list.description: View the hour-package catalog filtered by nationality tabs (COL/EXT/USA) with derived currency and computed totals.
admin-hour-packages-list.knownGaps: Spec does not assert view-mode toggle (tracked in admin-hour-packages-view-modes), pagination, or the mobile card variant (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-hour-packages-view-modes.name: Admin Hour Packages — View Modes
admin-hour-packages-view-modes.description: Admin switches the hour-package catalog between Tabla, Tarjetas (card grid) and Comparativa (pricing tiers highlighting 'Mejor tarifa') via a BaseSegmented control; the initial mode comes from GET /api/hour-packages/admin/settings/ (default_view_mode).

admin-impersonate-user.name: Impersonate User (Login with this user)
admin-impersonate-user.description: A superuser clicks "Login with this user" (in /panel/admins/ or the Django admin user page) and lands authenticated on /platform via the /platform/admin-login callback, which swaps a short-lived single-use exchange code for the session tokens.

admin-kanban-tasks.name: Admin Kanban Tasks
admin-kanban-tasks.description: Internal Kanban task board at /panel/tasks (alias /panel/tareas redirects here). Admin can create, edit, move across TO DO/In Progress/Blocked/Done columns, and delete tasks.

admin-layout-title-mapping.name: Admin Layout Browser Tab Title
admin-layout-title-mapping.description: Browser tab title in admin.vue updates reactively to show 'Project App (ViewName)' based on the current route. Covers: exact match (dashboard), static prefix match, more-specific route priority, and dynamic regex routes (/panel/proposals/:id/edit → 'Edit. propuesta').

admin-linkedin-module.name: Admin LinkedIn Content Module
admin-linkedin-module.description: Admin manages freeform LinkedIn posts at /panel/linkedin (sidebar section ProjectApp content): connection card shows OAuth status (connect/reconnect popup, token expiry date via GET /api/linkedin/status/), posts list from GET /api/linkedin/posts/ with status chips (Borrador/Programado/Publicado/Fallido), create/edit modal (commentary max 3000, optional image, optional schedule datetime) posting to /api/linkedin/posts/create/ | :id/update/, publish-now with confirm via POST /api/linkedin/posts/:id/publish/ (502 error surfaces inline), delete with confirm via /api/linkedin/posts/:id/delete/. Scheduled posts are published by Huey (ETA + minute sweep) server-side.
knownGaps: Scheduled auto-publish is a server-side Huey task — covered by backend tests, not browser E2E

admin-linktree-branding.name: Personalizar la marca del Linktree
admin-linktree-branding.description: Editar colores, cargar o quitar logo y elegir o añadir Google Fonts con vista previa y persistencia.

admin-linktree-templates.name: Plantillas HTML de Linktree
admin-linktree-templates.description: Cargar ZIP, archivos o carpeta; validar HTML y accesibilidad a 320/375/430 px; previsualizar en sandbox; publicar, restaurar y restablecer versiones; reemplazar imágenes editables y compartir la biblioteca entre proyectos del mismo cliente. Errores y fallos recuperables conservan la publicación actual.

admin-linktrees.name: Admin Linktrees
admin-linktrees.description: Admin creates linktrees (internal name + unique handle, personal/company kind), edits identity, tiered buttons (1 primary, <=1 featured, pairs of 2, <=6 rows), PWA block and vCard data from /panel/linktrees, and assigns a linktree as QR card destination. Public URL is /lk/@handle; the backend rejects handle collisions, reserved handles and tier cardinality violations.

admin-login.name: Admin Login
admin-login.description: Admin follows the panel hand-off to Django Admin and authenticates with mandatory reCAPTCHA v2. Invalid or unavailable verification blocks session creation.

admin-mcps.name: Admin MCPs Connectors
admin-mcps.description: Superuser manages MCP connectors at /panel/mcps: inspects risk-classified capabilities and requests and domain writes attributed to a non-interactive connector service actor, including document-thread, income-record and card-statement authorship; creates scoped/expiring credentials, edits scope, rotates or revokes each credential through the panel confirmation modal; receives every secret once; preserves the compatibility token and active toggle. Sensitive tools are identified as preview-plus-confirm actions. Server contracts reject malformed transport envelopes, invalid scopes or expiry, stale confirmations and unsafe temporary assets. Includes the superuser gate: staff non-superusers are redirected to /panel. At compact, portrait, landscape, desktop and wide profiles, credential labels, actors and request IDs remain readable without horizontal overflow; accordion triggers provide touch targets of at least 44px on compact and portrait; scope editing can be opened and cancelled on portrait. Groups canonical module connectors separately from retiring compatibility connectors; shows replacement and last legacy use, blocks new legacy credentials and preserves scoped legacy credential editing/revocation during migration.

admin-mini-crm-clients.name: Admin Mini-CRM Clients
admin-mini-crm-clients.description: View client list with search, client-status filtering (Todos/Activos/Huérfanos/Inactivos — a transversal selector next to the search box since the filters were reorganised by business module, no longer the top tab row), expand client to see linked proposals, and empty state. The global panel refresh button invalidates the per-client detail cache and refetches expanded rows so renamed/reassigned proposals appear.

admin-monitoring-case-follow-up.name: Admin Monitoring Case Follow-up
admin-monitoring-case-follow-up.description: Staff opens a case, reads technical evidence and history, changes its workflow state with concurrency protection and sees actionable errors.

admin-monitoring-case-list.name: Admin Monitoring Case List
admin-monitoring-case-list.description: Staff navigates to Monitoring and filters paginated project/server cases, source freshness and dates; load failures remain explicit.

admin-monitoring-case-note.name: Admin Monitoring Case Note
admin-monitoring-case-note.description: Staff records a note in the case history and keeps the typed text when validation or delivery fails.

admin-monitoring-reports.name: Admin Monitoring Reports
admin-monitoring-reports.description: Staff opens informational reports separately from cases, reads plain-text details and the retention notice, and sees load errors.

admin-outbound-email-history-attachments.name: Admin Inspects Exact Email Attachments
admin-outbound-email-history-attachments.description: Admin enters the universal email history, expands a primary delivery and recognizes every exact retained attachment by name, business type, format and size; PDF evidence opens in the shared protected viewer, confirmed empty deliveries say they had no attachments, and legacy rows disclose the archive gap instead of regenerating a file.

admin-outbound-email-history-body.name: Admin Inspects Retained Outbound Email Body
admin-outbound-email-history-body.description: Admin navigates to universal email history, expands a security delivery and opens the retained full body in the sandboxed viewer, matching the explicit policy that all admins can inspect even OTP and credential-bearing messages.

admin-outbound-email-history-filter.name: Admin Filters Universal Outbound Email History
admin-outbound-email-history-filter.description: Admin navigates to the universal outbound-email history and filters grouped primary deliveries by any Para/CC recipient, family, per-address status and date range, seeing one delivery row with all visible destinations rather than scanning duplicate recipient rows.

admin-outbound-email-history-resend.name: Admin Resends Exact Archived Email
admin-outbound-email-history-resend.description: Admin expands a captured grouped delivery, opens Reenviar exacto, edits the original Para and visible CC recipient lists through the same hybrid picker, and confirms (10 unique addresses total). Subject, body and attachments remain locked; success closes with confirmation and a server failure stays visible without claiming delivery.

admin-panel-projects.name: Admin Panel Projects Module
admin-panel-projects.description: The Plataforma space in the panel sidebar opens /panel/projects: the commercial face of accounts.Project, the entity hostings, incomes and cuentas de cobro reference. The listing loads once and filters client-side by the active, user-managed lifecycle catalog. At expanded widths, non-zero lifecycle and operational cards use the same four/five-column grid and 72–80px horizontal layout: identity stays left, count/action stays right and contextual help occupies a contained 48px column. Operational support copy remains one bounded line without changing card dimensions. Opening help never activates the card. At 412px and 835px the header remains exactly two actionable summaries whose contained help and drawers retain all lifecycle states, including zeroes, and every operational detail; the first project remains visible in the initial phone viewport. Activating a lifecycle indicator filters the list, while operational indicators open their corresponding workflow. Search remains accent/case-blind over project and client, sortable columns show name/client/state/created plus per-project hosting and income counts that — for superusers — link into the accounting tabs pre-filtered via ?project=<id>. The Clientes sin proyecto action opens a create path pre-seeded with that client. Create presents name, client, initial state and description as one full-width block; En desarrollo is visibly selected, so no contradictory default-state help is shown. Required-field errors appear under name and client after a save attempt, while the action row contains only Cancelar and Guardar. Client creation remains visible inside the picker even when search matches exist. Later lifecycle changes are excluded from edit and belong to the previewed transition flow. A same-name project warns without blocking. At 412px and 835px state filtering is a selector, sorting stays explicit and the listing becomes one/two-column cards; from 1195px the table returns. Create, edit, orphan assignment, client change and lifecycle dialogs are full-screen on phones, with sticky actions; the page is capped at 1400px on wide monitors. Las acciones ahora se agrupan en la primera columna sin título visible, mediante tres puntos; las tarjetas comparten el mismo menú. Eliminar sólo borra proyectos vacíos tras confirmar y muestra dependencias y cantidades cuando hay información que conservar.

admin-panel-session-expired.name: Admin Panel Session Expired
admin-panel-session-expired.description: Admin (or any browser with a stale/absent session) requests a /panel/* route other than /panel/login without a valid staff session. The admin-auth Nuxt middleware calls GET /api/auth/check/; on 401/403 it hard-redirects (window.location.href, a full page navigation, not navigateTo) to /admin/login/?next=<originally requested path> instead of rendering the panel, so signing in again returns the user to the page they requested.

admin-panel-unsaved-guard.name: Admin Panel Unsaved Changes Guard
admin-panel-unsaved-guard.description: The shared unsaved-changes guard as rolled out across the panel's full-page editors (blog, portfolio, linktrees, hour-packages, diagnostics/create, accounting/settings, emails), using /panel/emails as the representative case because its state lives in loose refs rather than a form object. Editing a default raises a warning naming the field (data-testid emails-defaults-unsaved-notice), and leaving the page opens the three-way dialog whose primary exit saves and only then navigates. Pins the boundary that matters for tabbed pages: switching tabs is a same-route router.replace({ query }), which must NOT trip the leave guard — otherwise every tabbed panel page would block on a modal as soon as its form had anything pending — and must not discard what is pending either.

admin-partnership-legacy-redirects.name: Enlaces anteriores del Programa de Alianza
admin-partnership-legacy-redirects.description: Abrir un enlace anterior de financiación redirige al Programa de Alianza conservando idioma, detalle, parámetros y autenticación.

admin-portfolio-create.name: Admin Portfolio Create
admin-portfolio-create.description: Create a new portfolio work via manual form or JSON import.

admin-portfolio-edit.name: Admin Portfolio Edit
admin-portfolio-edit.description: Edit an existing portfolio work including bilingual fields, cover image, content JSON, and SEO.

admin-portfolio-list.name: Admin Portfolio List
admin-portfolio-list.description: View the list of all portfolio works with status, edit/duplicate/delete actions.

admin-project-access-detail.name: Admin Project Access Detail
admin-project-access-detail.description: Panel staff opens a project's detail modal from the Projects list and sees repository, production/staging access cards, masked secrets, and notes; a failed load offers retry.

admin-project-access-field-edit.name: Admin Project Access Inline Field Edit
