admin-project-access-field-edit.description: Panel staff edits and explicitly saves one repository, site, Django-admin URL, username, or replacement password field; validation and server failures remain inline without losing the draft.

admin-project-access-notes.name: Admin Project Access Notes
admin-project-access-notes.description: Panel staff lists and adds titled project notes, optionally sensitive; required-field and backend failures preserve the note form for correction.

admin-project-access-secrets.name: Admin Project Access Secrets
admin-project-access-secrets.description: Panel staff sees credentials masked by default and explicitly reveals, hides, or copies a password or sensitive note; failed secret requests leave content masked.

admin-project-actions-menu.name: Acciones de proyectos desde tres puntos
admin-project-actions-menu.description: Desde Proyectos, la primera columna de la tabla no tiene título visible y contiene el botón de tres puntos. Tabla y tarjetas comparten un modal que conserva Ideas, detalle, plataforma, edición, marca, comunicaciones, estado e historial, y ofrece eliminar. Escape cierra el menú y devuelve el foco al botón.

admin-project-brand.name: Marca y recursos del proyecto
admin-project-brand.description: Vincular Linktrees y cargar, descargar o eliminar documentos y assets privados del proyecto.

admin-project-change-client.name: Admin Project Change Client Cascade
admin-project-change-client.description: El proyecto cambia de cliente desde el modal de edición mediante Cambiar cliente; el campo del formulario conserva su valor. Elegir el destino carga la vista previa con can_apply, blockers, blocker_counts, planned para Mover y Desvincular, e impact_hash. Si la historia financiera, las entregas o los tickets bloquean el cambio, muestra los motivos y la orientación de crear un proyecto nuevo para el cliente destino, oculta los modos y deshabilita la confirmación sin enviar POST a change-client/. Si el cambio está permitido, muestra los registros afectados y exige elegir Mover al nuevo cliente o Desvincular del proyecto cada vez. La confirmación envía expected_impact_hash junto con las listas de IDs de la vista previa; 409 records_not_found o records_changed recarga el impacto y descarta el modo elegido. Al aplicar, se actualiza el cliente visible del proyecto y queda auditoría de los registros afectados.

admin-project-change-history.name: Admin Project Change History
admin-project-change-history.description: Abre el detalle de accesos y su pestaña Historial; consulta URLs, notas y credenciales enmascaradas, revela un secreto por acción explícita y lo oculta al cerrar. El historial presenta fecha, autor, origen y cambios; carga 20 entradas por página. Evidencia antigua incompleta no se puede comparar. Errores de carga, consulta o comparación permiten reintentar.

admin-project-client-access-policy.name: Project field visibility policy
admin-project-client-access-policy.description: Admin explicitly enables each available project/access datum, saves a source-bound version and previews the limited client projection, handling stale values and load failures.

admin-project-delete.name: Eliminación protegida y selectiva de proyectos
admin-project-delete.description: Eliminar abre la revisión de dependencias. Un proyecto vacío admite la confirmación normal; cancelar no borra. Desde Cambiar estado, sólo un superusuario activa la eliminación forzada y elige categorías con interruptores apagados por defecto. Un interruptor apagado conserva sus datos bajo el mismo cliente, sin proyecto. Eliminar una categoría con dependencias obligatorias muestra la restricción y exige elegirlas manualmente. DELETE debe coincidir exactamente y la huella debe corresponder a la selección revisada. Cambiar una opción limpia la confirmación; un conflicto actualiza la revisión. La ficha operativa siempre desaparece; propuestas, cliente y auditoría independiente se conservan. La evidencia legal protegida y los datos compartidos siguen bloqueando. Las vistas previas fallidas permiten reintentar. Lo conservado se consulta desde la ficha del cliente.

admin-project-fly-create.name: Admin Project Fly Create From Selectors
admin-project-fly-create.description: Every project selector creates on the fly (mirror of the client selector, PA-24/PA-25): ProjectSelect is now a combobox over the client's already-fetched projects (local filtering, no server search) and when nothing matches it offers Crear proyecto with the typed term (Enter included). The inline panel lives inside the component itself — one reusable selector, not a per-modal solution, so the hosting and income modals gain the flow without changes and the cuenta de cobro inherits it through its stacked income modal. The panel pre-fills the name, shows the inherited client read-only, warns without blocking on a same-name collision, keeps itself open on a 400 with the backend message, and on success the new project is auto-selected and appended to the per-client picker cache (the all bucket dropped). Cancelling the outer form leaves the project standing: it is a record of its own, visible immediately in /panel/projects.

admin-project-idea-collection.name: Future-contract idea collection
admin-project-idea-collection.description: Admin opens the idea workspace from the selected project three-point menu, selects exact idea versions from one project and client, preserves internal snapshots for future evaluation and resolves stale or failed requests without changing contracts.

admin-project-inline-assign-offer.name: Admin Project Inline Create Assign Offer
admin-project-inline-assign-offer.description: The gap the Vastago case exposed: a project created inline from an accounting form picker (crear al vuelo) used to discard the annotated create response, so the operator was never told the client had older records without a project. Now the created event carries the unlinked_* counters and, when the form closes (saved OR cancelled - the project is a record of its own), the PA-51 assign modal opens with the server-fresh backlog; confirming assigns the checked ids and the response rows (cascaded liquid children included) fill the Proyecto cells of the open table without any reload. Since F7 (Aug 2026) the offer also lists the client's DOCUMENTS without a project — cuentas de cobro of any commercial status included, shown by their public number: filling an issued cuenta's missing project is organisational metadata with no other UI write path (the generic document PATCH refuses non-drafts), so this confirmed-list flow and the link_records_single_project command are its only vehicles. document_ids travel with the confirmed plan and unlinked_documents_count joins the per-row backlog counters.

admin-project-lifecycle-states.name: Admin Project Lifecycle Transitions
admin-project-lifecycle-states.description: From a project row, an admin changes the real lifecycle state only through an ordered two-step preview/apply dialog. Project-level legacy warnings remain contextual, while a missing target state, each receivable decision and a required direct-decommission note are presented beside their responsible controls; the footer contains only Cancel and Confirm. Selecting a state exposes its editable meaning and immutable system consequence help before the preview. En evolución records that a delivered product remains operating while its next version is developed, sharing the operating effect with Activo. Suspension is reversible and preserves caused debt while stopping new automatic billing; completion means a clean close; decommission is definitive, requires an explicit keep/write-off decision for every caused receivable, and a direct jump that did not pass through Suspended requires a note. A stale financial preview fails closed and remains open. The same row exposes the immutable dated episode history, including actor and note, and a failed-hosting signal only suggests suspension — it never applies it automatically.

admin-project-state-catalog.name: Admin Project State Catalog
admin-project-state-catalog.description: The Administrar estados action opens the shared state-catalog component scoped to projects. It shows the six seeded meanings (En desarrollo, Activo, En evolución, Suspendido, Completado and Dado de baja), contextual help, usage and historical counts, and lets the admin create, describe, rename, recolor, merge or retire reusable states. Create and edit identify required fields and keep validation beside the corresponding control after an attempted action; choosing no merge destination follows the same inline pattern, while permanent seed restrictions remain accessible help instead of a red blocker list. Suspendido is the single reversible-stop state: it stops new billing and reminders while preserving caused debt. Every project remains present in Documents and Communications; the lifecycle effect only groups it into the active or archived catalog without archiving its documents. Editable names and descriptions stay separate from the immutable operational effect and derived consequence help that control and explain billing and closure. A state in use cannot change effect or be retired, and failed catalog writes preserve the local draft so the user can retry.

admin-proposal-actions-modal.name: Admin Proposal Actions Modal
admin-proposal-actions-modal.description: Admin opens proposal action menus from the listing or edit page; the public preview action opens the client-facing proposal in a new tab without recording engagement.

admin-proposal-advanced-filters.name: Admin Proposal Advanced Filters
admin-proposal-advanced-filters.description: Filter proposals using custom saved tabs, status/type/market dropdowns, date range, and text search. Tab bar with add/rename/delete, URL deep-linking via ?tab=<tabId>.

admin-proposal-analytics.name: Admin Proposal Analytics
admin-proposal-analytics.description: View detailed analytics for a single proposal: funnel, heatmap, sessions, CSV export, and durable first-view alert delivery state.

admin-proposal-approval.name: Revisar la aprobación y vincular una propuesta
admin-proposal-approval.description: El equipo confirma cliente, proyecto y contratos antes de aprobar desde Propuestas o Clientes. Selecciona existentes o crea cliente y proyecto al confirmar. El paquete incluye contratos de la modalidad o personalizados, detalles curados comercial y técnico y todos los anexos activos. Cancelar conserva el estado; validaciones, conflictos y fallos conservan el formulario. Si ya existe un cierre y se vuelve a aprobar, se revisan las condiciones del borrador y se confirma un nuevo paquete.

admin-proposal-attach-from-documents.name: Admin Proposal — Adjuntar desde Documentos
admin-proposal-attach-from-documents.description: From the Correos tab of the proposal edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing all available documents: contract PDF + draft (if contract exists), commercial PDF, technical PDF, and any uploaded proposal_documents. Admin selects one or more items and clicks 'Adjuntar (N)'. Selected refs appear as emerald badges below the attachments block. On send, the POST body includes a doc_refs JSON field with the resolved refs. Sending is handled by admin-send-branded-email / admin-send-proposal-email; this flow covers only the selection UX.

admin-proposal-batch-actions.name: Admin Proposal Batch Actions
admin-proposal-batch-actions.description: Select multiple proposals via checkboxes and perform batch actions (re-send, expire, delete) with sticky action bar. (Ago 2026) The selection is reconciled against the loaded proposals, so deleting a selected row drops it from the batch bar's count and the bar leaves on its own once the selection empties.

admin-proposal-change-history.name: Admin Proposal Change History
admin-proposal-change-history.description: Abre Historial en una propuesta; consulta precio y alcance por versión, compara versiones o la última enviada correctamente y consulta su evidencia. El historial presenta fecha, autor, origen y cambios; carga 20 entradas por página. Evidencia antigua incompleta no se puede comparar. Errores de carga, consulta o comparación permiten reintentar.

admin-proposal-client-autocomplete.name: Admin Proposal Client Autocomplete
admin-proposal-client-autocomplete.description: Client picker autocomplete in proposal create/edit: type to search, select a client to auto-fill snapshot fields, fallback "Crear nuevo" when no match.

admin-proposal-client-no-email.name: Admin Proposal Client No Email
admin-proposal-client-no-email.description: Create a proposal without a client email — backend generates a placeholder email and all automations are paused for that client.

admin-proposal-comment.name: Admin Proposal Comment
admin-proposal-comment.description: Add internal comments to a proposal for team collaboration.

admin-proposal-contract-download.name: Admin Proposal Contract Download
admin-proposal-contract-download.description: Admin downloads final or draft contracts and formal commercial/technical PDFs from Documents, or the PDFs of draft proposals from General, without leaving the editor or opening a popup. Files keep the server filename; validation and network failures show a recoverable notification. Invalid HTML/JSON responses are never saved as PDFs.

admin-proposal-contract-edit.name: Admin Proposal Contract Edit
admin-proposal-contract-edit.description: Admin edits an existing contract's parameters via 'Editar parámetros' button in the Documents tab. Modal opens pre-filled with saved params. Submit calls contract update API.

admin-proposal-contract-generate.name: Admin Proposal Contract Generate
admin-proposal-contract-generate.description: Admin generates a development contract with ContractParamsModal. Two modes: 'Contrato por defecto' (fill contractor/client params form with auto-populated company settings) or 'Contrato personalizado' (paste/upload custom Markdown). Moving a sent or viewed proposal to negotiation calls save-and-negotiate; generating from the Documents tab of a negotiating proposal calls the contract update API. The Documents tab shows for sent/viewed/negotiating/accepted/rejected; generation is available from negotiating on. The list and editor keep the modal open with the draft when generation fails, allowing retry.

admin-proposal-contract-modality.name: Admin Proposal Contract Modality
admin-proposal-contract-modality.description: The administrator changes single/split in every proposal state. Outside negotiation a required note and owned preview precede confirm/cancel. Three explicit service terms are required for split. Custom text and PDF are preserved literally; conflicting custom destinations require explicit resolution. Previous contracts and linked sent/signed documents remain intact without automatic delivery or signatures. Permanent snapshots can be consulted, downloaded and restored from proposal history with a new reviewed change. Existing service-generation dialogs retain their own presets, validation, stale-contract warnings and compact responsive layout.

admin-proposal-contract-terms-visibility.name: Admin Proposal Contract Terms Visibility
admin-proposal-contract-terms-visibility.description: Admin chooses whether a Spanish proposal exposes the generic Contract and terms mode during creation or from the proposal edit screen.

admin-proposal-create-and-send.name: Admin Proposal Create & Send
admin-proposal-create-and-send.description: Create and send proposal in one step when client data is complete.

admin-proposal-create-from-json.name: Admin Proposal Create (JSON Import)
admin-proposal-create-from-json.description: Create a proposal by importing a pre-filled JSON payload. The optional metadata field _meta.optional_metadata.email_intro is flattened into BusinessProposal.email_intro and remains editable in Correos; generated JSON should provide a client-specific plain-text problem-to-solution-to-outcome message so create-and-send is immediately eligible.

admin-proposal-create-preview.name: Admin Proposal Create Preview
admin-proposal-create-preview.description: Post-creation interstitial modal with preview, send, and edit options.

admin-proposal-create.name: Admin Proposal Create
admin-proposal-create.description: Create a new business proposal with sections and requirements.
knownGaps: Hosting defaults seeding on mount (hosting_percent + hosting_discount_* from GET proposals/defaults, 2026-07) is not asserted.
JSON-tab total_investment now uses BaseCurrencyInput (live thousand separators); formatting behavior not asserted.

admin-proposal-dashboard-auto-refresh.name: Admin Proposal Dashboard Auto-Refresh
admin-proposal-dashboard-auto-refresh.description: Dashboard KPI panel auto-refreshes every 60s with manual refresh button and last-updated label.

admin-proposal-dashboard.name: Admin Proposal Dashboard
admin-proposal-dashboard.description: View global KPI dashboard for all proposals: conversion rate, trends, rejection reasons.

admin-proposal-defaults-config.name: Admin Proposal Defaults Config
admin-proposal-defaults-config.description: Manage default section configurations for new proposals (ES/EN), with save and reset-to-hardcoded. Saving sections states the version loaded, so a snapshot left open across another write is refused instead of rewinding the stored defaults.

admin-proposal-defaults-slug-pattern.name: Admin Proposal Defaults — Slug Pattern
admin-proposal-defaults-slug-pattern.description: Admin configures the default slug pattern used when new proposals are created (e.g. {client_name}, {client_name}-{year}). Live preview shows the slugified result. Saved to ProposalDefaultConfig.default_slug_pattern via PUT /api/proposals/defaults/.

admin-proposal-delete-from-client.name: Admin Proposal Delete From Client
admin-proposal-delete-from-client.description: From /panel/clients, expand a client row and delete a specific linked proposal. A confirm modal requires typing 'DELETE'; on success the client detail is refetched (proposal disappears) and a success toast shows; on 409 (linked to a launched project) the proposal stays and an error toast shows.

admin-proposal-delete.name: Admin Proposal Delete
admin-proposal-delete.description: Delete an existing business proposal from /panel/proposals. A confirm modal requires typing 'DELETE'; on success the list refreshes and a success toast shows; on 409 (proposal linked to a launched project via ProjectPhase on_delete=PROTECT) the proposal stays and an error toast surfaces the backend message.

admin-proposal-dev-checklist.name: Admin Proposal Dev Checklist Tab
admin-proposal-dev-checklist.description: Admin generates, copies and downloads the Markdown developer checklist from the Desarrollo tab of an accepted proposal (client-side markdown build).
knownGaps: No spec yet (2026-07 audit): tab only appears for accepted proposals; refresh/copy/download untested.

admin-proposal-diagnostic-templates.name: Proposal — Documentos Tab
admin-proposal-diagnostic-templates.description: El administrador abre Documentos en cualquier estado de la propuesta, incluido borrador, vencida y finalizada. La pestaña muestra los contratos activos según su modalidad, los PDFs formales comercial y técnico y Documentos adjuntos con su formulario de carga. No muestra la antigua sección Enviar documentos al cliente.

admin-proposal-discount-offer-send.name: Admin Proposal Discount Offer Send
admin-proposal-discount-offer-send.description: From /panel/proposals/:id/edit the seller opens the actions menu and picks 'Enviar oferta de descuento' — only shown when discount_percent > 0 and the client has an email. A modal renders the server-side email preview (POST /api/proposals/:id/email-preview/, template proposal_urgency); confirming sends the offer (POST /api/proposals/:id/discount-offer/send/ → ProposalEmailService.send_urgency_email force=True) and shows a success toast. Never auto-sent.

admin-proposal-document-markdown.name: Admin Proposal Document Markdown
admin-proposal-document-markdown.description: From the Documentos tab of a sent, viewed, negotiating, accepted, or rejected proposal, admin copies the Markdown for a generated development contract, formal commercial proposal, formal technical specification, or compatible attachment. PDF copy reconstructs extracted text with a warning; DOCX and XLSX copy and preview textual content and tables. PDF and image previews retain their original rendering, and every attachment can be downloaded as its original file.

admin-proposal-document-preview.name: Admin Proposal Document Preview
admin-proposal-document-preview.description: From the Documents tab of the proposal edit page, admin opens an attachment preview from its title or eye icon without leaving the current screen. PDFs render in an iframe and images in an img element; DOCX and XLSX files render their extracted Markdown text and tables with an extraction warning. Legacy DOC/XLS and unsupported formats leave preview disabled while preserving original-file download. The modal closes through its close control or backdrop.

admin-proposal-documents-manage.name: Admin Proposal Documents Manage
admin-proposal-documents-manage.description: Admin uploads additional documents (otrosí, legal annex, client document, other with custom label) to a proposal via the Documents tab. Lists existing documents with type badges. Delete non-generated documents.

admin-proposal-documents-send.name: Admin Proposal Documents Send (SUPERSEDED)
admin-proposal-documents-send.description: SUPERSEDED Apr 22 2026: The 'Enviar al cliente' section was removed from the Documents tab. Documents are now attached from the Correos tab via 'Adjuntar desde Documentos' (see admin-proposal-attach-from-documents). The spec admin-proposal-documents-send.spec.js was deleted. This flow entry is kept for historical traceability only.
knownGaps: Flow superseded — 'Enviar al cliente' section removed from the Documents tab on 2026-04-22; replaced by admin-proposal-attach-from-documents via the Correos tab. Entry retained for historical traceability.

admin-proposal-download-pdf.name: Descargar PDF original de propuesta desde el panel
admin-proposal-download-pdf.description: General descarga los PDFs comercial y técnico por la ruta administrativa, incluso para propuestas vencidas. Documentos conserva sus anexos formales.

admin-proposal-duplicate.name: Admin Proposal Duplicate
admin-proposal-duplicate.description: Duplicate an existing proposal to create a new draft copy.

admin-proposal-edit.name: Admin Proposal Edit
admin-proposal-edit.description: Edit an existing business proposal through General, Propuesta, Comunicación, Documentos, Proyecto and Seguimiento, with visible secondary navigation and status-gated destinations. Documentos remains available in every proposal state, including draft and finished. Legacy tab links resolve to the corresponding group and section; navigation retains unsaved editors and selected video files, loads panels on first visit and preserves unrelated URL parameters and fragments. Includes Propuesta → Detalle técnico where each requirement can be linked to commercial items (linked_item_ids checkboxes) for item-requirement traceability. The technical editor renders its sections collapsed by default (headers with counts; bodies mount on expand via technical-section-toggle-<key>) and the per-requirement link grids live behind a 'Vincular alcance/ítems' disclosure (technical-req-links-toggle); the JSON sub-tab mounts only when opened. Proyecto > Datos está disponible en todos los estados y conserva el vínculo del cliente; contactos y ajustes de Comunicación > Correos guardan de forma independiente del borrador de General. Recursos pertenece a Propuesta. Los enlaces antiguos Comunicación/Recursos se redirigen a esa subpestaña sin perder otros parámetros.
knownGaps: Automations toggle switched to positive polarity (ON = automations running, 2026-07); knob position/aria-checked not asserted and the toggle lacks a data-testid.

admin-proposal-engagement-decay-alert.name: Admin Proposal Engagement Decay Alert
admin-proposal-engagement-decay-alert.description: System creates engagement_decay alert when client views fewer sections than average.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

admin-proposal-engagement-score.name: Admin Proposal Engagement Score
admin-proposal-engagement-score.description: Engagement score (0-100) per proposal in analytics tab with color-coded level and recommendation.

admin-proposal-explainer-preference.name: Admin Proposal Welcome Video Preference
admin-proposal-explainer-preference.description: Admin changes one proposal’s welcome-video preference in General and sees why it cannot currently appear. A successful save persists the preference; a failed update restores the previous value and reports the failure.

admin-proposal-explainer-visibility.name: Admin Proposal Welcome Video Visibility
admin-proposal-explainer-visibility.description: Admin opens Propuestas → Configuraciones, previews the compact welcome video and changes global visibility. A failed save restores the previous switch and reports the failure. Playback starts only after a click, pauses when the page or window loses activity, and never resumes automatically on return.

admin-proposal-first-view-retry.name: Admin Proposal First-view Alert Retry
admin-proposal-first-view-retry.description: From proposal analytics, an admin retries a failed first-view alert and sees either the queued state or a preserved failure state.

admin-proposal-formalization-delivery.name: Admin Proposal Formalization Delivery
admin-proposal-formalization-delivery.description: Admin prepares a formalization email from proposal Documents, selects original-content annexes and attachments (commercial keeps ten ordered chapters; technical keeps stack, data model and product modules; each PDF has consecutive chapter numbers), reviews frozen email and files, then sends them once. Missing documents, stale previews and uncertain deliveries are visible.

admin-proposal-functional-requirements-f.name: Admin Functional Requirements (Form)
admin-proposal-functional-requirements-f.description: Manage requirement groups and items using the structured form interface. The contextual cross-cutting group is present after specific features and cannot be deleted as a whole, while its title, description and items remain editable. The section preview mirrors the public render, including per-item 'Ver requerimientos (N)' links built from the proposal's technical_document.

admin-proposal-functional-requirements-p.name: Admin Functional Requirements (Paste Content)
admin-proposal-functional-requirements-p.description: Bulk-fill requirement group items by pasting formatted text.

admin-proposal-hour-rate.name: Admin Proposal Hourly Rate (Auto/Manual)
admin-proposal-hour-rate.description: Set a proposal's hour-package rate from the «Tarifa por hora» tab: automatic keeps syncing from the HourPackage catalog, manual overrides the base rate (and optionally a per-package rate) for that proposal only, with a live preview of the table the PDF prints.

admin-proposal-inline-status-change.name: Admin Proposal Inline Status Change
admin-proposal-inline-status-change.description: Change proposal status directly from the proposals table via inline dropdown. The draft→sent transition is delegated to ProposalService.send_proposal so the client email is dispatched and Huey reminders are scheduled (defense-in-depth — same behavior as the dedicated 'Enviar al Cliente' button). Response includes email_delivery and the panel toast surfaces failures with the reason.

admin-proposal-json-import-client-picker.name: Admin Proposal JSON Import — Client Picker
admin-proposal-json-import-client-picker.description: In the 'Datos de la propuesta' form of JSON-import mode (/panel/proposals/create), the client name pre-fills from the imported JSON and a ClientAutocomplete lets the seller link an existing client (sends client_id, shows the (#id) hint, syncs sections.general.clientName) or create a new one inline.

admin-proposal-json-import-warnings.name: Admin Proposal JSON Import Warnings
admin-proposal-json-import-warnings.description: JSON import returns warnings for unmapped section keys; warnings displayed in post-creation modal.
knownGaps: Covered within admin-proposal-create.spec.js

admin-proposal-list.name: Admin Proposal List
admin-proposal-list.description: View the list of all business proposals.

admin-proposal-log-activity.name: Admin Proposal Log Activity (Edit Page)
admin-proposal-log-activity.description: Admin logs seller activity from the proposal Activity tab and reads automatic client module-interest changes. Activity loads twenty entries initially via GET /api/proposals/:id/activity/, then follows its signed cursor through Cargar más beyond fifty entries. Failed requests preserve loaded rows and allow retry; new notes remain visible when the initial page arrives.

admin-proposal-manual-alerts.name: Admin Proposal Manual Alerts
admin-proposal-manual-alerts.description: Create, view, and dismiss manual seller alerts/reminders for proposals.

admin-proposal-metrics-manual.name: Admin Proposal Metrics Manual
admin-proposal-metrics-manual.description: Floating ? button opens slide-over with searchable metric definitions.

admin-proposal-module-interests.name: Admin Proposal Module Interests
admin-proposal-module-interests.description: The administrator reads the latest module-interest list and date in General and the automatic change entry in Activity, without modifying scope or investment.

admin-proposal-multi-send.name: Admin Proposal Multi Send
admin-proposal-multi-send.description: From /panel/proposals/:id/edit, the lightning menu opens ProposalMultiSendModal with same-client proposals grouped by status. The current proposal is selected and locked; the admin selects 2–10 proposals. Every selected proposal must have a nonblank personalized message: missing-message badges, Correos links, and an alert keep the action disabled. POST /api/proposals/:id/send-multi/ sends one email whose numbered phase blocks each render that proposal's message and attach its PDF, then applies the normal send/reopen/resend side effects.

admin-proposal-platform-handoff.name: Admin Proposal → Platform Handoff
admin-proposal-platform-handoff.description: After a proposal is accepted, admin clicks 'Lanzar a plataforma' from the actions modal — POST /api/proposals/:id/launch-to-platform/ — which creates a PlatformProject linked to the proposal and sends the client a platform invitation email with an OTP. Admin sees a 'Ver en plataforma' action in the proposal actions panel. Client then starts the platform onboarding flow (platform-login → platform-verify-onboarding → platform-complete-profile).

admin-proposal-post-rejection-revisit.name: Admin Proposal Post-Rejection Revisit
admin-proposal-post-rejection-revisit.description: System creates post_rejection_revisit alert when rejected proposal is revisited.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

admin-proposal-project-reassignment.name: Admin Proposal Project Reassignment
admin-proposal-project-reassignment.description: Admin opens Proyecto > Datos on a linked proposal, selects another active project of the same client, enters a reason, reviews the impact and confirms. Confirmation updates the project link while preserving proposal identity and approved evidence. A stale impact requires a fresh preview; a server failure keeps the reviewed impact and stable request identifier for retry.

admin-proposal-project-schedule.name: Admin Proposal Project Schedule (Cronograma)
admin-proposal-project-schedule.description: Admin sets per-stage start/end dates (design, development) for an accepted proposal in the Cronograma tab, sees proportional status badges, and marks stages as completed to silence deadline alerts.

admin-proposal-prompt.name: Admin Proposal Prompt Tab
admin-proposal-prompt.description: Admin copies, edits, downloads and resets the commercial and technical proposal-generation prompts from the Prompt tab (localStorage-persisted; parallel of admin-diagnostic-prompt).
admin-proposal-prompt.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (round 7): action bar, edit->save revealing the reset action, cancel discarding the draft.

admin-proposal-quick-log.name: Admin Proposal Quick Log Activity
admin-proposal-quick-log.description: Register a seller activity (call, meeting, follow-up, note) directly from the proposals list via quick-log modal.

admin-proposal-quick-send.name: Admin Proposal Quick Send
admin-proposal-quick-send.description: Send or re-send a proposal directly from the proposals list without entering edit page.

admin-proposal-reopen-from-expired.name: Admin Proposal Reopen From Expired
admin-proposal-reopen-from-expired.description: Recover an expired proposal by extending expires_at to a future date from /panel/proposals/:id/edit (General tab) or via the JSON re-import panel. The serializer no longer blocks re-saving when expires_at is unchanged, and ProposalService.reopen_if_unexpired auto-reverts status from 'expired' to 'viewed' (when view_count > 0) or 'sent', logging an 'Auto-reopened from expired…' entry in ProposalChangeLog. Covers both PATCH /proposals/:id/update/ and PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ paths.

admin-proposal-resend.name: Admin Proposal Resend
admin-proposal-resend.description: Resend an already-sent proposal from the actions modal. An editor preloads the retained personalized message, lets the admin change it, and disables resend while it is blank. 'Guardar y re-enviar' persists the edited email_intro and POSTs /proposals/:id/resend/; the delivery keeps expires_at, resets sent_at and reminder timers, and returns email_delivery. Prior email snapshots remain unchanged.

admin-proposal-scorecard.name: Admin Proposal Pre-Send Scorecard
admin-proposal-scorecard.description: View a 1-10 completeness scorecard with blockers before sending a proposal.

admin-proposal-section-add-delete.name: Admin Proposal Section Add/Delete
admin-proposal-section-add-delete.description: Admin adds a missing section type from the "Agregar sección" modal (seeded server-side from language defaults via POST /api/proposals/:id/sections/create/) and deletes sections via the per-row trash action (DELETE /api/proposals/sections/:id/delete/), including the backend guard for functional requirements with a confirmed calculator selection.

admin-proposal-section-completeness.name: Admin Proposal Section Completeness
admin-proposal-section-completeness.description: Progress bar showing percentage of enabled sections with content in the edit view.
knownGaps: Both tests assert only the label; percentage value and color-coding never asserted (2026-07 audit).

admin-proposal-section-dirty-guard.name: Admin Proposal Section Dirty Guard
admin-proposal-section-dirty-guard.description: Unsaved-changes protection in the proposal section editor: editing a section shows a "Sin guardar" badge; collapsing a dirty section, navigating away, reloading or hitting the panel refresh button asks for confirmation before discarding edits. The page-level guard now runs on the shared useUnsavedGuard (same composable as admin-document-unsaved-guard) and renders a notice above the tab strip — outside every tab, since the pending work may sit in one the operator is not looking at — naming what is pending ("Secciones y tarifa por hora sin guardar") instead of only reporting that something is. It stays a two-exit dialog (salir sin guardar / seguir editando): the proposal has no atomic save, each SectionEditor saves its own block, so a "Guardar y salir" would promise something this page cannot yet deliver.

admin-proposal-section-disable.name: Admin Proposal Section Disable/Enable Toggle
admin-proposal-section-disable.description: Admin toggles section visibility (is_enabled) from the Secciones tab of the proposal edit page. Each section row has an enable/disable toggle; disabled sections are greyed out in the admin list and excluded from the public proposal view. PATCH /api/proposals/sections/:id/update/ with { is_enabled: false }. Complements admin-proposal-section-reorder — both operations can be combined in sequence.
knownGaps: Admin side covered; no assertion that a disabled section disappears from the public view (2026-07 audit).

admin-proposal-section-edit-form.name: Admin Proposal Section Edit (Form)
admin-proposal-section-edit-form.description: Edit proposal sections using structured form fields for each of the 12 section types.
knownGaps: value_added_modules section editor is not exercised; its money fields (min_price_usd/cop) use BaseCurrencyInput (2026-07). commercial_conditions covered 2026-07-28; its hour rates moved to the admin-proposal-hour-rate flow on 2026-07-28 and this spec now only asserts they round-trip untouched.

The hosting subsection's free-month visibility checkbox (hostingPlan.freeMonthsVisible, 2026-09-05) is not driven through the admin UI here: its round trip is covered by unit tests on buildFormFromJson/formToJson (SectionEditor.test.js) and its public effect by the proposal-hosting-plan-terms E2E flow.

admin-proposal-section-edit-paste.name: Admin Proposal Section Edit (Paste Content)
admin-proposal-section-edit-paste.description: Bulk-fill proposal section fields by pasting text and processing it into structured form data.

admin-proposal-section-reorder.name: Admin Proposal Section Reorder
admin-proposal-section-reorder.description: Reorder commercial sections via drag & drop in the Secciones tab (vuedraggable handle per row); the permuted order slots POST to /api/proposals/:id/reorder-sections/ with snap-back on failure.

admin-proposal-section-sync.name: Admin Proposal Section Sync (Preview & Apply)
admin-proposal-section-sync.description: Admin uses the SyncPreviewModal on the proposal edit page to preview a server-computed diff between the current section's content_json and the canonical default, then applies the sync to overwrite. Backend endpoints: GET /api/proposals/sections/:id/sync-preview/ and POST /api/proposals/sections/:id/apply-sync/. UI lives at frontend/components/BusinessProposal/admin/SyncPreviewModal.vue (mounted in pages/panel/proposals/[id]/edit.vue).

admin-proposal-send.name: Admin Proposal Send
admin-proposal-send.description: Send a proposal from the list or edit page. The Correos tab is available while the proposal is a draft and saves the editable plain-text email_intro independently. Every send requires a nonblank message; the scorecard links back to Correos when it is missing. Delivery renders the predefined body, then the personalized problem-to-solution-to-outcome message, then commercial blocks, and attaches the proposal PDF. Backend returns email_delivery so the panel distinguishes delivery success from SMTP/template failure.
admin-proposal-send.knownGaps: The server-side PDF-attachment side effect on send is backend-only and not asserted at the UI layer.

admin-proposal-shared-documents.name: Consultar documentos compartidos y confirmar sus revisiones
admin-proposal-shared-documents.description: Desde la propuesta y el gestor, consultar la misma identidad documental, su paquete vigente y su historial. Editar fuentes estructuradas o sustituir adjuntos habilitados en borrador. Confirmar otro paquete conserva las versiones anteriores y el cliente y proyecto vinculados. Un conflicto conserva el archivo; revisar explícitamente la versión vigente permite reintentar sin perder la selección.

admin-proposal-slug-edit.name: Admin Proposal Slug Edit
admin-proposal-slug-edit.description: Admin sets or regenerates the human-friendly slug (URL personalizada) for a proposal from the General tab. Includes format validation (lowercase/numbers/hyphens), uniqueness error on 400, and one-click regeneration from client name. PATCH /api/proposals/:id/update/ with { slug }.

admin-proposal-update-client.name: Admin Proposal Update Client
admin-proposal-update-client.description: Desde Proyecto > Datos de la edición, cambiar el cliente de una propuesta que todavía no está vinculada a un proyecto. El administrador selecciona otro cliente y usa Guardar cliente; los contactos se actualizan sin guardar el borrador de General. Si ya existe un proyecto vinculado, el propietario queda bloqueado y su cambio requiere la acción de cliente del proyecto.

admin-proposal-update-from-json.name: Admin Proposal Update From JSON
admin-proposal-update-from-json.description: Re-import a complete JSON payload over an existing proposal from /panel/proposals/:id/edit. Pastes/uploads JSON → PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ replaces metadata and section content_json. Different from admin-proposal-create-from-json (creation): targets an existing proposal id, supports keeping expires_at unchanged on expired proposals, and surfaces unknown-key warnings.
knownGaps: Happy path only; unknown-key warnings surfacing and keep-expires_at-on-expired branch unasserted (2026-07 audit).

admin-proposal-win-rate-dashboard.name: Admin Proposal Win Rate Dashboard
admin-proposal-win-rate-dashboard.description: Dashboard win rate segmented by project type, market type, and combination.

admin-proposal-zombie-segment.name: Admin Proposal Zombie Segment
admin-proposal-zombie-segment.description: Dark-themed collapsible zombie alerts section for stale draft/sent proposals.

admin-proposals-config-tab.name: Admin Proposals — Configuraciones Tab
admin-proposals-config-tab.description: Admin activates the fixed trailing 'Configuraciones' tab of the proposals filter-tab bar (right-aligned on desktop, select option on mobile): the list swaps to the shared ViewSettingsPanel with the proposal saved-filter-tabs reset (view=proposal) and a link to /panel/proposals/defaults. Selecting any filter tab closes the panel. The settings panel also manages service-contract option catalogs and defaults; that interaction is covered by admin-service-contract-settings.

admin-pwa-install.name: Install the internal panel
admin-pwa-install.description: An operator installs ProjectApp from the desktop sidebar or mobile menu. Native installation can be accepted, cancelled or fail; browsers without a prompt show localized help. A dismissible invitation appears on the dashboard once per browser session, without displacing content in operational modules. Standalone mode hides installation controls.

admin-pwa-offline.name: Retry the panel after losing connectivity
admin-pwa-offline.description: The installed panel requests the real Django session on launch. If a panel or Django login navigation fails at the network boundary, a localized offline page offers Retry at the original URL. Reconnection restores the online page; continued loss keeps the notice. The worker does not cache data or intercept API calls, writes, public pages or platform routes. Executed against the generated build through playwright.pwa.config.js.

admin-qr-cards.name: Admin QR Cards
admin-qr-cards.description: Admin creates QR cards (name required, destination URL optional) that get a UUID short link (/t/:uuid/) redirecting to the configurable destination. QR always encodes the short link, never the destination. Download modal customizes foreground/background color and transparency client-side, without persisting the choice.

admin-secure-link-create.name: Admin Secure Link Create
admin-secure-link-create.description: Admin creates a one-time secure link. Confidential message is the default type; required fields (and the credentials username) remain visible while optional fields are in More details, and client, project, language and validity are collapsed under optional Settings. Saving shows the URL and copy actions. Sharing is manual: the flow creates no draft and sends no message automatically. Custom requires a type name and content; validation errors, catalog retry and recoverable server failures preserve retryable input.

admin-secure-link-manage.name: Admin Secure Link Management
admin-secure-link-manage.description: Admin views, searches and filters secure links by ready, sent, opened, expired and revoked lifecycle states, including received links and audit history, and reloads the list from the panel refresh button. Each row starts with an unlabeled three-dot button that opens an actions modal: detail and history, edit content, copy URL, manual sent mark, revoke or reactivate, and delete. The admin can manually mark an active team-created link as sent, which records the acknowledgement without sending a message; can reveal content without consuming the public link, rename the title in place from the detail, edit the content through a single edit option, revoke, reactivate or delete it. A recipient explicitly revealing the public link changes the displayed lifecycle to opened; reactivation returns it to ready. Copying the public client page keeps the button label and header geometry stable, confirms actual clipboard success with a temporary check and floating accessible status, and permits retry after clipboard failure.

admin-seller-inactivity-escalation.name: Admin Seller Inactivity Escalation
admin-seller-inactivity-escalation.description: Periodic task sends escalation email for proposals with >=5 days no seller activity.
knownGaps: Backend-only periodic task, covered by backend unit tests

admin-send-branded-email.name: Admin Send Branded Email (Negotiating)
admin-send-branded-email.description: Admin sends one branded marketing email from the Correos tab of a proposal in negotiating/accepted/rejected status to multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients. The shared hybrid picker starts with the proposal client, searches registered clients or accepts manual addresses, and enforces 10 unique destinations. Composer also has draggable Markdown sections, attachments, real-template preview and grouped paginated history. Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/branded-email/send/, GET defaults/history and POST /api/emails/preview/.

admin-send-proposal-email.name: Admin Send Proposal Email (Sent+)
admin-send-proposal-email.description: The Correos tab is visible from draft onward. Its first card edits and previews the proposal's plain-text personalized send message; drafts may save it empty, although initial send is blocked until completed. After the first send, the same tab exposes a follow-up composer for multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients through the hybrid client/manual picker (10 unique addresses total), plus immutable grouped history. Each delivery writes one ProposalChangeLog activity, updates last_activity_at and appears once while retaining one status row per address. The composer also supports Markdown sections, preview and attachments through the proposal-email endpoints.

admin-service-contract-settings.name: Admin Service Contract Settings
admin-service-contract-settings.description: An admin opens Configuraciones in Propuestas to manage global duration and shared notice options and their three independent defaults. Saving applies to future modal openings without rewriting existing contracts. Validation, load retry and failed-save preservation are visible.

admin-standalone-email-attachments.name: Admin Standalone Email Attachments
admin-standalone-email-attachments.description: Admin attaches files to a standalone email from /panel/emails: multiple file input (.pdf/.doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx/.png/.jpg), client-side type and size validation via validateEmailAttachments (~/utils/emailAttachments), per-file remove button, and multipart POST /api/emails/send/ including the attachments. Documented as Branch B of admin-standalone-email-composer but never exercised by its spec.
admin-standalone-email-attachments.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign round 3): valid upload sent in multipart POST, type-validation rejection and per-file remove over mocked API.

admin-standalone-email-composer.name: Admin Standalone Email Composer
admin-standalone-email-composer.description: Admin composes and sends one branded email from /panel/emails to one or more visible Para recipients and optional CC recipients. The shared hybrid picker searches registered clients or accepts manual addresses, rejects duplicates/placeholders, and enforces 10 unique addresses across both headers. Page-level tabs (Redactar / Historial / Valores por defecto, deep-linked via ?tab=). Redactar also supports draggable sections with per-section Markdown, file attachments and server-rendered preview. Historial groups all visible destinations under one delivery. Endpoints: emails/send/, emails/preview/, emails/defaults/, emails/history/.
admin-standalone-email-composer.knownGaps: Spec does not exercise: add/remove/drag-reorder sections, send-error path, history entry expand/collapse, "Cargar más" pagination. Attachments split out to admin-standalone-email-attachments (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-standalone-email-defaults.name: Admin Standalone Email Defaults Config
admin-standalone-email-defaults.description: Admin configures the standalone email composer defaults from the 'Valores por defecto' tab of /panel/emails (deep-linkable via ?tab=defaults): default greeting (with {client_name}/{title} variables), default footer and default signer. Saved via PUT /api/emails/defaults/ into EmailTemplateConfig('branded_email').content_overrides; 'Restaurar valores originales' submits registry/settings defaults which clears the overrides. The configured signer is used for standalone sends and previews (proposal emails keep their per-proposal signer).
admin-standalone-email-defaults.knownGaps: Spec does not exercise Branch A ("Restaurar valores originales") nor Branch B (invalid signer 400) (2026-07-16 audit).

admin-styleguide.name: Admin Styleguide
admin-styleguide.description: Executable design-system contract: light/dark snapshots plus responsive behavior at 412, 835, 1195, 1440 and 2560 px.

admin-task-alert-management.name: Admin Task Alert Management
admin-task-alert-management.description: Admin defines one or more manual date-based email alerts per task from the TaskFormModal Alertas section. Supports add (date + optional note), list with sent/pending badge, and delete. Alerts fire via Huey daily at 08:10.

admin-task-deadline-notification.name: Admin Task Deadline Notification
admin-task-deadline-notification.description: Huey periodic task sends email notifications to task assignees at 40%, 70%, 100% of deadline and for overdue tasks. Backend-only — no browser interaction.
knownGaps: Backend-only Huey periodic task. Covered by backend unit tests; no E2E spec applies.

admin-view-map.name: Admin View Map
admin-view-map.description: Open the panel route inventory, filter grouped views, and copy route references for support and QA communication. Copy controls keep the contextual accessible name, omit the duplicate browser-native title, and expose one short application tooltip. Includes three complementary modes: Lista for the full inventory, Mapa for module cards and route drill-down, and Explorador for a contextual journey through three product spaces: Panel interno, Plataforma de clientes, and Experiencias públicas. The Explorer exposes representative modules and submodules, updates business and operational context on hover or focus, supports card navigation on compact viewports and an orbital layout from landscape upward, and offers free or guided navigation. Shareable state uses ?viewMode=explorer&node=<id>; guided tours add ?tour=<space-id> and preserve the current node when the user exits. It also supports slow automatic rotation, drag and keyboard controls, zoom, reduced-motion preferences, functional relations, and search. Ships seeded filter tabs (Admin, Público, Cliente, Dashboards, Configuración) and a Configuración section that persists the default view mode and default filters in the ViewMapSettings backend singleton; ?viewMode= overrides the configured default and localStorage no longer persists the last-used mode.
knownGaps: Configuración default-filters autosave (debounced PATCH + toast) and default-filters application on open are unit-covered only (2026-07 audit).
Saved-tab CRUD (create/rename/delete) unasserted on view_map; shared ProposalFilterTabs component is exercised in proposals specs (2026-07 audit).

admin-whatsapp-suggestion.name: Admin WhatsApp Suggestion
admin-whatsapp-suggestion.description: System creates whatsapp_suggestion alert with pre-drafted message based on top viewed section.
knownGaps: Backend-only, covered by backend unit tests

blog-detail.name: Blog Post Detail
blog-detail.description: Read a blog post with structured JSON content (sections, timelines, lists, subsections) or HTML fallback, sources, share, related posts.

blog-list.name: Blog Listing
blog-list.description: Browse the blog listing with search, category filters, featured hero post, and responsive grid/mobile cards.

diagnostic-public-dark-mode.name: Diagnostic Public Dark Mode Toggle
diagnostic-public-dark-mode.description: Client toggles dark/light mode via the fixed bottom-left button; the [data-diagnostic-wrapper] element receives data-theme='dark'. Preference persists to localStorage['diagnostic-dark-mode'] and is restored on next page load.

diagnostic-public-onboarding.name: Diagnostic Public Onboarding
diagnostic-public-onboarding.description: First-visit tutorial overlay on the public diagnostic page (DiagnosticOnboarding.vue) that walks the client through the report's structure with step-by-step tooltips, scroll-to-section behavior, and a 'No volver a mostrar' option persisted to localStorage. Mirrors proposal-view-onboarding for the diagnostic module.
knownGaps: DiagnosticOnboarding component (376 lines) shipped 2026-04-26 (commits 9877df24, e827bd38). Component-level unit tests exist (DiagnosticOnboarding.test.js); E2E spec pending.

diagnostic-public-pdf-download.name: Diagnostic Public PDF Download
diagnostic-public-pdf-download.description: Client uses the floating PDF button on the public diagnostic page; browser fetches GET /api/diagnostics/public/:uuid/pdf/. The button shows a spinner while generating and re-enables after the download completes.
knownGaps: Production PDF is generated by ReportLab on the fly; E2E mocks a 200 PDF response and validates the UI path.

diagnostic-public-phase-visibility.name: Diagnostic Public Phase Visibility
diagnostic-public-phase-visibility.description: The public diagnostic page renders different sections depending on the diagnostic phase. After admin sends initial phase (initial_sent_at set, status=SENT), only sections with visibility ∈ {initial, both} appear. After admin sends final phase (final_sent_at set), sections with visibility='final' (e.g. executive_summary, cost, timeline) are also returned by the API and appear in the sidebar. E2E should mock two API responses (initial-phase vs final-phase) and assert which section types render in each state.

diagnostic-public-respond.name: Diagnostic Public Respond
diagnostic-public-respond.description: On a final-phase SENT public diagnostic, the client clicks 'Aceptar propuesta' or 'Rechazar' in the footer — POST /api/diagnostics/public/<uuid>/respond/ with `decision` ('accept'|'reject'), the page swaps to the acceptance/rejection confirmation footer, and the backend transitions the diagnostic to ACCEPTED or REJECTED. The CTA only appears on the last section (or once the cost section was visited) and asks for confirmation before POSTing, with an explicit sending state.

diagnostic-public-share.name: Diagnostic Public Share
diagnostic-public-share.description: Client clicks the floating share button on the public diagnostic page; a modal opens with the current URL and a 'Copiar enlace' action. Optionally uses Web Share API if available.

diagnostic-public-view.name: Diagnostic Public View
diagnostic-public-view.description: Client accesses the public diagnostic page via UUID link and navigates the JSON-driven section components (Purpose/Radiography/Categories/DeliveryStructure/ExecutiveSummary/Cost/Timeline/Scope). Initial-phase view hides `final`-only sections. Per-section dwell time is tracked via /api/diagnostics/public/<uuid>/track-section/. Accept/Reject is a separate flow (`diagnostic-public-respond`). Since the Jul 2026 redesign the page opens with a personalized cover ('Comenzar recorrido' starts the tour) and sections swap with a directional slide.

layout-footer-navigation.name: Footer Navigation
layout-footer-navigation.description: Navigate using footer links and social media links.

layout-icon-interaction-feedback.name: Visible Icon Interaction Feedback
layout-icon-interaction-feedback.description: Activate an icon-only action and receive a restrained 420 ms press, upward hop and landing without a border effect. Reduced-motion users receive a static contrast change. Clipboard success temporarily changes the copy glyph to a check and shows a nearby result only after the browser resolves the write; failure keeps the copy glyph available for retry.

layout-locale-switch.name: Locale Switch
layout-locale-switch.description: Switch the application language between English and Spanish.

layout-navbar-navigation.name: Navbar Navigation
layout-navbar-navigation.description: Navigate between pages using the fixed top navbar.

platform-access-view.name: Legacy Platform Access Redirect
platform-access-view.description: Compatibility route at /platform/access that redirects to the project list. Project credentials now live in each admin-only /platform/projects/:id/access detail.

platform-admin-client-detail.name: Platform Admin Client Detail
platform-admin-client-detail.description: Admin-only client detail page with profile card, edit form (name, company, phone, active toggle), quick actions (resend invite, deactivate/reactivate).

platform-admin-client-list.name: Platform Admin Client List
platform-admin-client-list.description: Admin-only client management table with invite modal (create + send credentials), status filters (Todos/Onboarded/Pendientes/Inactivos), search, resend invite, and deactivate actions.

platform-admin-project-create.name: Platform Admin Project Create
platform-admin-project-create.description: Admin creates a new project via modal form with name, description, client selector, start date, and estimated end date. A manual root folder already using the project name triggers a server-side conflict error when it cannot be adopted automatically; a safe homonymous manual root is automatically adopted without creating a duplicate folder, and the adoption can be undone.

platform-bug-reports.name: Platform Bug Reports
platform-bug-reports.description: Client reports a general project bug without a guide or captures the original published requirement. Team replies use server-owned public conversation, selected sources, verified citations and explicit human review; no contract keeps scope indeterminate. Private provenance, team resolution and reopening preserve history without changing guide approvals.

platform-change-requests.name: Platform Change Requests
platform-change-requests.description: Client requests a change against a published requirement. Original contract, scope, phase, stage, round and version remain frozen. The shared source engine verifies contractual reply citations against a server-captured conversation before explicit human publication; private provenance stays hidden. Conversion creates a new draft in an explicit stage of the applicable contract.

platform-client-document-portal.name: Platform Client Document Portal
platform-client-document-portal.description: Client lands on /platform/documents after first login: main contract plus annexes render and each can be downloaded as PDF.

platform-client-document-sign.name: Platform Client Document Sign
platform-client-document-sign.description: Client accepts/signs the main document via click-to-accept (gated on a verified email); the signature is recorded and the team is notified.

platform-client-email-validation.name: Platform Client Email Validation
platform-client-email-validation.description: Client validates their account email via a 6-digit OTP sent from the documents portal before signing is unlocked.

platform-collection-account-detail.name: Platform Collection Account Detail
platform-collection-account-detail.description: Consulta snapshot, importes, líneas, instrucciones de pago y contexto explícito de una cuenta permitida; descarga el PDF emitido y recupera errores del documento o archivo sin modificarlo.

platform-collection-accounts-list.name: Platform Collection Accounts List
platform-collection-accounts-list.description: Consulta cuentas emitidas del cliente con agrupación y filtros explícitos por proyecto, naturaleza, contrato, otrosí y estado; navega al detalle y ofrece vacío y reintento de lectura.

platform-complete-profile.name: Platform Complete Profile
platform-complete-profile.description: Mandatory profile completion form with company, phone, cedula, date of birth, gender, education level, and optional avatar upload. Middleware gates dashboard access until completed.

platform-dashboard.name: Platform Dashboard
platform-dashboard.description: Admin dashboard shows KPI cards (active/pending/inactive clients), recent clients table, and upcoming modules. Client dashboard shows profile summary and upcoming modules.

platform-deliverable-detail.name: Platform Deliverable Detail
platform-deliverable-detail.description: The retired standalone deliverable detail route /platform/projects/:id/deliverables/:deliverableId preserves compatibility by redirecting to the project resources list.

platform-deliverables.name: Platform Deliverables
platform-deliverables.description: Admin uploads project resources with version history. The library preserves designs, documents, credentials, APKs and other resources and displays contracts, amendments and legal annexes in their own groups. Client downloads the exact current or previous file through the authenticated Platform API. A denied or interrupted download shows its explanation without closing the detail or creating a browser artifact; pending downloads disable duplicate requests. Per-project view at /platform/projects/:id/deliverables and unified cross-project view at /platform/deliverables.

platform-delivery-authoring.name: Platform Delivery Authoring
platform-delivery-authoring.description: Prepare contracts, amendments, scopes, independent execution phases, stages and validation requirements. A contract or amendment selects exactly one source: a project document, proposal PDF, or file from the confirmed approval package, including customized files. A newly selected confirmed file remains private until reviewed and does not establish a signature; a non-PDF source remains downloadable in its original format, while a recorded external signature makes the retained signed PDF the canonical copy. Publish a stage only with complete guides and signed applicable agreements. A source-backed guide that names a product role must state access/data, allowed and blocked actions, permitted and blocked verification steps and expected results; a rejected publication preserves the draft until it is completed.

platform-delivery-closure-email.name: Platform Delivery Closure Email
platform-delivery-closure-email.description: Reach a fully approved stage through the Platform portal in Spanish or English, preserve that locale during navigation, prepare an exact private closure-email preview, confirm a manual send, inspect delivery history and explicitly prepare a resend with the same frozen evidence.

platform-delivery-guide-prompt.name: Platform Guide Prompt Sources
platform-delivery-guide-prompt.description: Select one contract and applicable amendments or annexes, retain exact sources with readable fragments and warnings, then preview verified JSON before applying guide drafts without requiring an existing stage.

platform-delivery-import.name: Platform Delivery JSON Import
platform-delivery-import.description: Copy the authoring prompt, preview a strict versioned JSON hierarchy, then apply drafts atomically. Reject malformed JSON, imported approvals and edits to already published content.

platform-delivery-notices.name: Platform Delivery Notice History
platform-delivery-notices.description: An administrator navigates from a project to Delivery, reads the persisted delivery-notice history, previews the exact retained copy of a confirmed failed notice, and explicitly retries that reviewed manifest. Sending or unknown outcomes require manual review and are never automatically retried.

platform-delivery-reply-prompt.name: Platform Response Prompt Sources
platform-delivery-reply-prompt.description: Prepare a stage response using retained contractual sources and public review history, verify request classifications and citations, then review the final message before manually sending it with optional documents; incomplete sources cannot establish outside scope.

platform-delivery-responses.name: Platform Delivery Responses
platform-delivery-responses.description: Send contextual responses on a published stage with a message and optional existing document links, then read the recorded response history.

platform-delivery-review.name: Platform Delivery Review
platform-delivery-review.description: Navigate from a project to published nontechnical guides, approve selected requirements, object or reject with a motive, preserve earlier conformity through corrections, and derive stage/phase closure.

platform-hosting-card-delete.name: Platform Hosting Card Delete
platform-hosting-card-delete.description: From the project payments page, when a card is on file, the client sees an 'Eliminar tarjeta' button next to 'Cambiar tarjeta'. Clicking it opens a confirmation modal warning that automatic billing will be disabled. On confirm, DELETE /api/accounts/projects/:id/subscription/card/remove/ best-effort deletes the Wompi payment source and clears the stored card fields on the subscription, so has_payment_source becomes false and the 'Activa el cobro automático / Registrar tarjeta' state reappears. The button is hidden for admins and for archived subscriptions.
platform-hosting-card-delete.knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (QA campaign round 5): confirm delete restoring the register state, cancel without API call, and the in-modal error branch over mocked API.

platform-hosting-card-setup.name: Platform Hosting Card Setup (3DS)
platform-hosting-card-setup.description: Client registers a card once for automatic hosting billing. From the project payments page the client opens the card modal, enters card data, and the card is tokenized into a Wompi payment source. When the card requires 3D Secure, an authentication flow runs (browser-info/fingerprint hidden iframes, then a visible bank challenge iframe) polled every 2s until the source is AVAILABLE. On success the card is stored on the subscription and the first open payment is charged. The same flow handles 'Cambiar tarjeta'. A failed payment can be retried manually with the stored card. E2E mocks Wompi + 3DS (the challenge iframe is :srcdoc, no live sandbox): the AVAILABLE happy path and the PENDING → 3DS challenge path.

platform-hosting-project-list.name: Platform Hosting Project List
platform-hosting-project-list.description: Lista los proyectos con hosting en /platform/payments y abre cada proyecto mediante una fila real; ofrece vacío y reintento de lectura.

platform-hosting-subscription.name: Platform Hosting Subscription
platform-hosting-subscription.description: On the project payments page the client sees a per-phase hosting cost table (one row per project phase + total) with frequency pills (quarterly/semiannual/every 9 months — the nine-month plan carries the biggest discount; monthly and annual are not offered) that recompute the total live, and activates the subscription at the chosen frequency. The subscription bills the sum of all started phases; future-dated phases join later prorated. Billing always starts on the 1st of a calendar month and the client gets a free hosting period from project delivery until that first billing date (always at least one full month), so the first charge is deferred to the 1st rather than charged on activation day. While the subscription is pending the client can still change the frequency (pills stay editable, the first payment realigns); it locks once the first payment settles (table becomes display-only). Card is the only payment method. After activation the client registers a card (see platform-hosting-card-setup) for automatic recurring billing. Admin sees subscription status and stored-card info. Netflix-style active state shows the next automatic renewal date. The per-project commercial view remains at /platform/projects/:id/payments; the global /platform/payments hosting list links to that project context.
knownGaps: The free-month gift and always-bill-on-the-1st alignment are backend date rules, unit-tested in accounts/tests/test_hosting_multiphase.py; no dedicated UI assertion. The nine-month pill select, recompute, activate and pending-plan change are covered.

platform-layout-title-mapping.name: Platform Layout Browser Tab Title
platform-layout-title-mapping.description: Browser tab title in platform.vue updates reactively to show 'Project App (ViewName)'. Covers: static route (dashboard, projects), dynamic project base route (/platform/projects/:id → 'Proyecto'), and nested dynamic route ordering (/platform/projects/:id/board → 'Tablero' beats project base regex).

platform-legacy-route-redirects.name: Platform Legacy Route Redirects
platform-legacy-route-redirects.description: Retired global Platform routes redirect to projects; the former project board redirects to that project's delivery workspace.

platform-login.name: Platform Login
platform-login.description: Client or admin authenticates with mandatory reCAPTCHA v2 before JWT or first-login OTP issuance. Provider errors block login with retry; verified users retain onboarding and role-based destinations.

platform-notifications.name: Platform Notifications
platform-notifications.description: In-app notification center with unread count badge in sidebar, filter tabs (all/unread/read), mark-all-read, and click-to-navigate deep links to the relevant project module (board, changes, bugs, deliverables).

platform-password-reset.name: Platform Password Reset
platform-password-reset.description: Client recovers access from /platform/login → 'Olvidé mi contraseña': requests a reset code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/request/), enters the 6-digit code (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/verify-code/) and sets a new password (POST /api/accounts/password-reset/confirm/), then returns to login. Public platform pages: forgot-password, verify-code, reset-password.

platform-profile-avatar-picker.name: Platform Profile Avatar Picker
platform-profile-avatar-picker.description: Open the native single-image file chooser from the accessible avatar action on the profile page.

platform-profile-edit.name: Platform Profile Edit
platform-profile-edit.description: View and update personal profile fields (name, company, phone, cedula, DOB, gender, education) with avatar display and role badge.

platform-project-access-detail.name: Platform Project Access Detail
platform-project-access-detail.description: An admin edits access data via JWT; the client stays on a limited empty projection until fields are explicitly enabled. Load failures remain recoverable.

platform-project-client-access.name: Explicit client access
platform-project-client-access.description: A client sees only approved project/environment fields, explicitly reveals a granted credential and loses that action when revoked. Default hidden access preserves other modules.

platform-project-collection-accounts.name: Platform Project Collection Accounts
platform-project-collection-accounts.description: Consulta las cuentas del proyecto con agrupación y filtros de contrato, otrosí, hosting y estado, sin incorporar cuentas de otro proyecto; abre el detalle y permite reintentar la lectura.

platform-project-data-model.name: Platform Project Data Model
platform-project-data-model.description: Admin uploads a JSON data model for a project (copy/download template, file upload or paste, validate, submit). Both roles see the entity table (name, description, keyFields, relationship). Empty state and error/retry state.

platform-project-detail.name: Platform Project Detail
platform-project-detail.description: Project summary with client and dates, navigation to delivery scopes/phases/stages, commercial references, and an admin edit modal.

platform-project-hosting-context.name: Platform Project Hosting Context
platform-project-hosting-context.description: Consulta el único contexto de hosting del proyecto, fuentes contables, suscripción, pagos, ciclos y grupos de evidencia. Identifica fuentes pendientes sin sumarlas ni crear cobros; navega a cuentas de hosting y permite reintentar la lectura.

platform-project-ideas.name: Project suggestions
platform-project-ideas.description: The current client writes or corrects suggestions with preserved authorship and revision history, with object isolation and recoverable failed submissions.

platform-project-list.name: Platform Project List
platform-project-list.description: Admin sees all projects with catalog-derived state filters (Todos plus the states present, including Suspendido) and a create button. Client sees only their assigned projects. Card grid with progress bars and estimated dates.

platform-proposal-auto-onboarding.name: Proposal Acceptance Awaiting Internal Review
platform-proposal-auto-onboarding.description: ARCHIVED — La aprobación es exclusivamente interna mediante revisión confirmada de cliente, proyecto y contrato. Las invariantes de aprovisionamiento se verifican en API y servicios.

platform-secure-link-create.name: Platform Client Secure Link Create
platform-secure-link-create.description: Client creates a team-only link from the existing text/credential catalog in their own project. No files, third-party recipients, or internal-access imports. Sensitive input and URL remain in the modal. Repeated request_id with identical normalized input returns metadata without URL; changed input conflicts and offers an explicit new identifier.

platform-secure-link-manage.name: Platform Client Secure Link Manage
platform-secure-link-manage.description: Client lists and filters only their own project links, views safe history, renames, explicitly retrieves an active URL, revokes, or explicitly reactivates with a rotated token for 1/3/7 days. No secret-content read, content overwrite, deletion, files, third parties or internal-access imports.

platform-secure-link-replace.name: Platform Client Secure Link Replace
platform-secure-link-replace.description: Client confirms correction, revoking the source while preserving ciphertext and audit history, then creates a linked replacement with blank sensitive fields. Creation failure leaves the source revoked. One direct successor is allowed; substituted sources cannot reactivate. No old-secret read, in-place edit, deletion, files, third parties or internal-access imports.

platform-sidebar-navigation.name: Platform Sidebar Navigation
platform-sidebar-navigation.description: Left sidebar layout with collapsible navigation (Principal, Proyectos, Administración sections), mobile hamburger drawer, theme toggle (light/dark), profile link, and logout.

platform-verify-onboarding.name: Platform Verify & Onboarding
platform-verify-onboarding.description: First-login OTP verification with 6-digit code input, new password set, and role-aware redirect: clients land on /platform/documents, admins on the dashboard (via complete-profile when pending).

proposal-closing-contact.name: Proposal Closing Contact
proposal-closing-contact.description: Client reaches the final panel and reviews the commercial calls to action and contact channels.

proposal-comment-from-closing.name: Proposal Comment from Closing
proposal-comment-from-closing.description: Client submits written comments from the closing panel via comment modal.

proposal-conditional-acceptance.name: Proposal Conditional Acceptance (ARCHIVED)
proposal-conditional-acceptance.description: ARCHIVED — Public acceptance and its condition form were removed; internal review is required.
knownGaps: Feature removed; no active browser journey.

proposal-contract-draft-download.name: Proposal Contract Draft Download
proposal-contract-draft-download.description: Client downloads the unsigned, watermarked draft from the persistent floating PDF action in Contract and terms mode; the introduction does not duplicate that action.

proposal-contract-terms.name: Proposal Contract Terms
proposal-contract-terms.description: Client opens the fourth proposal mode, reads the current masked global contract inside a bordered paper surface, jumps from the clause index to the selected clause, retries a temporary load failure, and cannot force the mode when it is unavailable.

proposal-countdown-realtime.name: Proposal Countdown Realtime
proposal-countdown-realtime.description: HH:MM countdown timer when proposal expires within 48 hours.

proposal-discount-multi-section.name: Proposal Discount Multi-Section
proposal-discount-multi-section.description: Discount badge visible in Investment banner, Calculator footer, and ProposalClosing special price badge.

proposal-download-pdf.name: Proposal PDF Download
proposal-download-pdf.description: Descarga comercial o técnica de propuestas vigentes; bloqueo explicado por vencimiento y reintento ante errores.

proposal-engagement-tracking.name: Proposal Engagement Tracking
proposal-engagement-tracking.description: After five visible seconds, the public proposal sends a validated heartbeat; the backend records the session and durable first-view alert without counting the document GET.

proposal-executive-to-detailed.name: Proposal Executive to Detailed View Switch
proposal-executive-to-detailed.description: Client switches from executive view to full detailed proposal via 'Ver Propuesta Completa' button with branded transition overlay.

proposal-expired-graceful.name: Proposal Expired Graceful
proposal-expired-graceful.description: Expired proposal returns 410 with partial data; frontend renders ProposalExpired with client name, WhatsApp CTA, and email contact.

proposal-functional-requirements-modal.name: Proposal Functional Requirements Modal
proposal-functional-requirements-modal.description: Client sees the four core cards (views, components, specific features and contextual cross-cutting features) and clicks a requirement group card to open its detail modal with items, icons and descriptions. Items with linked technical requirements show a 'Ver requerimientos (N)' link that opens a nested modal listing each requirement title, priority and description (detailed and executive modes; hidden on legacy proposals without item ids).

proposal-gateway-guide.name: Proposal Gateway Guide and External Resources
proposal-gateway-guide.description: Before choosing a reading mode, the proposal gateway guides the client through its available video and cards, and opens Additional Modules and Partnership Program in separate tabs.

proposal-hosting-plan-terms.name: Proposal Hosting Plan Terms
proposal-hosting-plan-terms.description: In the Investment section of the public proposal (/proposal/:uuid) the current hosting offer shows exactly three payment-frequency tiers (every 9 months 40% / semiannual 20% / quarterly 10%; monthly and annual are not offered) and a free-hosting-month gift bucket whose title reflects the real count ('1 mes' / 'N meses').
