The bucket is gated by the explicit hostingPlan.freeMonthsVisible checkbox, NOT by the count being non-zero; content saved before that flag existed falls back to the old rule (count > 0) so historical proposals look unchanged. The public API and downloadable PDF share the same normalized terms — including the free-month copy, which the backend fills with a per-language default when the operator leaves it empty — in Spanish and English. Closed or inactive proposals preserve their stored historical tiers. The renewal conditions (for each renewal year from the second year the cost grows by Colombian SMLMV increase % + a fixed 8% over the previous year) render ONLY in the downloadable PDF, NOT in the web view.
knownGaps: The dedicated Playwright spec covers the Spanish public path; English labels and PDF pricing are covered by focused backend/unit tests rather than a second E2E variant.
The PDF side of the visibility checkbox is covered by backend tests (test_proposal_pdf_free_months.py), not by an E2E download assertion.

proposal-kickoff-disclosure.name: Proposal Kickoff Disclosure
proposal-kickoff-disclosure.description: Client reviews the commitment and kickoff in readable columns at laptop and desktop widths, then expands the disclosure with the information required before the schedule starts.

proposal-magic-link-request.name: Proposal Magic Link Request (Expired)
proposal-magic-link-request.description: Guest who lands on an expired proposal submits their email to receive a fresh magic-link via the form in ProposalExpired.vue. Calls POST /api/proposals/request-link/ with { email } and shows a neutral confirmation message ('Si tenemos propuestas asociadas a ese email, recibirás un enlace en breve.') regardless of backend outcome to avoid leaking which emails are clients. Out of scope of proposal-expired-graceful (which covers the expired-state UI).

proposal-module-interests.name: Proposal Module Interests
proposal-module-interests.description: From detailed Investment, the client reviews the public catalog by category without prices and saves interests without changing contracted scope, investment, timeline or PDF.

proposal-negotiate.name: Proposal Negotiate (Accept with Changes)
proposal-negotiate.description: Client clicks 'Aceptar con cambios' → negotiate modal → required comment → submit → negotiating success state.

proposal-og-meta-personalized.name: Proposal OG Meta Personalized
proposal-og-meta-personalized.description: Personalized Open Graph meta tags for WhatsApp/social media previews.

proposal-onboarding-mobile-swipe.name: Proposal Onboarding Mobile Viewport
proposal-onboarding-mobile-swipe.description: Onboarding tooltip steps render correctly on mobile viewport with navigation buttons.

proposal-payment-plan-closing.name: Proposal Payment Plan in Closing
proposal-payment-plan-closing.description: Display payment plan milestones and the total with their currency and tax suffix near the accept button in the closing section.

proposal-post-acceptance-welcome.name: Proposal Post-Acceptance Welcome Kit
proposal-post-acceptance-welcome.description: After acceptance: PDF download, onboarding timeline, and PM WhatsApp contact.

proposal-pre-expiration-discount-suggest.name: Pre-Expiration Discount Suggestion
proposal-pre-expiration-discount-suggest.description: Periodic task creates discount_suggestion alert for viewed proposals expiring within 5 days.
knownGaps: Backend-only periodic task, covered by backend unit tests

proposal-process-methodology.name: Proposal Process & Methodology
proposal-process-methodology.description: 5-step visual pipeline section (Discovery → Diseño → Desarrollo → QA → Lanzamiento).

proposal-rejection-optional-reason.name: Proposal Rejection Optional Reason
proposal-rejection-optional-reason.description: Rejection reason is optional with nudge text encouraging feedback.

proposal-rejection-smart-recovery.name: Proposal Rejection Smart Recovery
proposal-rejection-smart-recovery.description: After rejection, context-specific recovery cards render based on rejection reason with appropriate CTAs.

proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.name: Proposal Resolved Notice Suppression
proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.description: When a proposal is in a resolved status (accepted, rejected or finished), the public view at /proposal/:uuid hides time-sensitive / urgency notices that no longer make sense after the client's decision is settled: the expiration countdown badge (ExpirationBadge), the limited-time discount banner (Investment.vue .discount-banner) and the hosting tier discount badges. While the proposal is still open (sent/viewed) those notices keep showing. The `expired` status is handled separately by the expired-state banner.
knownGaps: Documented-only (expectedSpecs 0): no dedicated Playwright spec yet. Suggested e2e/proposal/proposal-resolved-notice-suppression.spec.js mocking GET /api/proposals/:uuid/ with status 'accepted'/'finished' and an expires_at + discount_percent set, asserting the ExpirationBadge and .discount-banner are absent; and a control case with status 'sent' asserting they render. Unit-level coverage exists in frontend/test/components/Investment.test.js (resolved-status notice suppression).

proposal-respond.name: Proposal Respond
proposal-respond.description: El cliente puede rechazar la propuesta o solicitar negociación. La aprobación requiere revisión interna de cliente, proyecto y contrato desde el panel.

proposal-roi-projection.name: Proposal ROI Projection
proposal-roi-projection.description: ROI Projection section renders KPI cards (visualizations, MRR, payback, ad reach), per-scenario blocks (cons/realistic/optimistic) with metrics and emphasis flag for totals, and a closing CTA note. The section sits between conversion_strategy and investment so the sponsor sees quantified business outcomes before the price. Web-only (no PDF renderer). Each existing proposal received a disabled empty row via migration 0118; admins enable + populate per-proposal.

proposal-schedule-followup-reminder.name: Proposal Schedule Follow-up Reminder
proposal-schedule-followup-reminder.description: After rejecting with "not the right time", the client clicks the reminder CTA which POSTs proposals/:uuid/schedule-followup/ and flips to a scheduled-confirmation state.

proposal-section-onboarding.name: Proposal Section Onboarding
proposal-section-onboarding.description: Per-section tutorials explain the additional-modules catalog and commercial interests, expandable requirements, and access to detailed investment.

proposal-share.name: Proposal Share
proposal-share.description: Client shares the proposal with a stakeholder via tracked share link.
knownGaps: Only asserts button visibility + modal open; tracked share-link creation POST/copied URL unasserted (2026-07 audit).

proposal-slug-access.name: Proposal Slug Access
proposal-slug-access.description: Client accesses a proposal via its human-friendly slug URL (/proposal/<slug>/). The store detects non-UUID identifiers and routes the request to the by-slug API endpoint. UUID-based access must still work for backward compatibility. Unknown slugs must render the 404/not-found state.

proposal-sticky-bar-accept.name: Proposal Sticky Bar Accept (ARCHIVED)
proposal-sticky-bar-accept.description: ARCHIVED — ProposalResponseButtons component removed from production. Acceptance handled via ProposalClosing section buttons.
knownGaps: Feature removed from production. Flow archived.

proposal-structured-negotiation.name: Proposal Structured Negotiation Modal
proposal-structured-negotiation.description: Negotiate modal with structured checkbox reasons and tab toggle for adjust vs comment.

proposal-summary-kpis.name: Proposal Summary KPIs
proposal-summary-kpis.description: Proposal Summary displays personalized KPI cards and keeps the investment currency and tax suffix visible in its standard summary cards.

proposal-technical-view.name: Proposal Technical View Mode
proposal-technical-view.description: Client opens public proposal with ?mode=technical to read the technical document (synthetic panels from technical_document) plus closing, and jumps to a section from the cover index.

proposal-value-added-modules.name: Proposal Value Added Modules
proposal-value-added-modules.description: Public proposal section (section_type value_added_modules) renders a card grid of included-free modules resolved from the proposal's functional_requirements groups. Each card shows title, icon, justification text, and a 'Gratis' badge. An optional footer_note is displayed below the grid. Falls back to 'Incluido sin costo adicional' when no title is provided in content_json. Clicking a card opens the shared requirements modal, including the nested linked-requirements link when technical requirements reference the module item ids. Per-module conditions gate benefits: when the effective total is below the module minimum a 'Disponible en proyectos desde $X' badge is shown (condicionado; never hidden), plus optional duration and discretionary-note badges. A 'Términos y condiciones' button opens a per-module ModuleTermsModal without triggering the card detail modal.
knownGaps: Terms modal now renders **bold** via renderInlineBold (2026-07); bold output not asserted (mock terms carry no ** markers).
Canonical card order admin>manual>kpi_dashboard>analytics>ai_automation (2026-07) not asserted.

proposal-view-navigation.name: Proposal View Navigation
proposal-view-navigation.description: Navigate between proposal sections using prev/next buttons and ProposalIndex panel.

proposal-view-onboarding.name: Proposal View Onboarding
proposal-view-onboarding.description: After selecting detailed or executive mode, the existing guide explains proposal navigation and reading time; it is independent of the gateway guide.

proposal-view-paste-rendering.name: Proposal View Paste Mode Rendering
proposal-view-paste-rendering.description: Client views paste-mode sections rendered as RawContentSection with markdown in a styled card, while form-mode sections render structured Vue components.

proposal-view.name: Proposal View
proposal-view.description: View a business proposal shared via unique UUID link with horizontal scroll.

proposal-welcome-back.name: Proposal Welcome Back
proposal-welcome-back.description: Returning client sees welcome-back overlay with name and last visited section.

public-about-us.name: About Us (archived)
public-about-us.description: ARCHIVED — page removed from navigation, no internal links. View the about us page with team and company information.
public-about-us.knownGaps: Page exists but is unreachable from navigation. Flow archived.

public-additional-modules-catalog.name: Public Additional Modules Catalog
public-additional-modules-catalog.description: Visitor follows the public footer link, switches the bilingual catalog between Spanish and English, uses card, list or remembered accordion mode, and can retry a failed live load.

public-additional-modules-detail.name: Public Additional Module Detail
public-additional-modules-detail.description: Visitor opens a module card, reads all five explanatory blocks in a modal, closes it, and returns to the same card.

public-additional-modules-explainer.name: Public Additional Modules Explainer
public-additional-modules-explainer.description: Visitor finds the one-minute explainer video under the catalog title (also on shared selections), plays it inline with sound and native controls, gets a direct file link when the browser cannot play it, and sees no card when the panel switch or the shared link hides the video. Playback starts only after a click, pauses when the page or window loses activity, and never resumes automatically on return.

public-additional-modules-guide.name: Public Additional Modules Guide
public-additional-modules-guide.description: First-time visitor sees a catalog-specific guide once, starting at the explainer video card, and can reopen it later from the floating restart control.

public-additional-modules-pdf.name: Public Additional Modules PDF
public-additional-modules-pdf.description: Visitor downloads the full or shared-selection PDF in the active language and receives the server's unavailable response when that selection is no longer valid.

public-additional-modules-share.name: Public Additional Modules Selection
public-additional-modules-share.description: Prospect opens a generated private link, sees only its selected modules without internal tracking data, can switch its language, can copy the unchanged current selection URL, and gets a clear unavailable state for a revoked link.

public-additional-modules-theme.name: Public Additional Modules Theme
public-additional-modules-theme.description: Visitor can read distinct page, card and detail surfaces in either theme, restore that theme on later visits and navigate softly revealed categories with reduced-motion support.

public-building-on-demand-estimator.name: Public Building on Demand Estimator
public-building-on-demand-estimator.description: Consultar las tareas del estimador vacío y seleccionar cantidades para leer el rango total del pedido, su encaje por nivel y la sugerencia según horas y roles; preparar el resumen para WhatsApp.

public-building-on-demand-faq.name: Public Building on Demand FAQ
public-building-on-demand-faq.description: Expandir una pregunta frecuente para consultar las condiciones de la bolsa mensual y contraer la respuesta desde el mismo control.

public-building-on-demand-guide.name: Public Building on Demand Guide

public-building-on-demand-pdf.name: Public Building on Demand PDF

public-building-on-demand-share.name: Public Building on Demand Share
public-building-on-demand-share.description: Abrir el diálogo Compartir Building on Demand, copiar el enlace actual y leer la confirmación; si se rechaza el portapapeles, conservar el enlace seleccionable y leer el aviso.

public-building-on-demand-terms.name: Public Building on Demand Terms
public-building-on-demand-terms.description: Cambiar el plazo mensual por uno anticipado para comparar precios mensuales, descuentos, total y ahorro; leer que la bolsa se renueva cada mes sin acumularse.

public-building-on-demand-theme.name: Public Building on Demand Theme
public-building-on-demand-theme.description: Alternar el tema de la presentación y sus controles flotantes; conservar la preferencia al recargar y al recuperar una carga fallida mediante Reintentar.

public-building-with-us-faq.name: Public Building with Us FAQ
public-building-with-us-faq.description: Expandir una pregunta frecuente y leer la respuesta sobre la participación ganada por hitos.

public-building-with-us-guide.name: Public Building with Us Guide
public-building-with-us-guide.description: Recibir la guía de nueve pasos en la primera visita, avanzar, omitirla y reiniciarla desde el control flotante.

public-building-with-us-language.name: Public Building with Us Language
public-building-with-us-language.description: Cambiar a English y leer el programa en inglés conservando la ruta pública localizada.

public-building-with-us-load.name: Public Building with Us Load
public-building-with-us-load.description: Abrir un enlace público con la API indisponible, leer el error y reintentar hasta recuperar el programa.

public-building-with-us-overview.name: Public Building with Us Overview
public-building-with-us-overview.description: Navegar desde el pie público, leer industrias y aportes de cada parte, consultar periodos de incubación y saltar a un modelo desde el índice.

public-building-with-us-pdf.name: Public Building with Us PDF
public-building-with-us-pdf.description: Descargar el PDF localizado; si falla la solicitud, leer el aviso sin perder el programa.

public-building-with-us-share.name: Public Building with Us Share
public-building-with-us-share.description: Abrir el diálogo y copiar la URL actual; ante rechazo del portapapeles, conservar el enlace seleccionable y leer el error.

public-building-with-us-theme.name: Public Building with Us Theme
public-building-with-us-theme.description: Cambiar al tema oscuro, recargar y recuperar una carga fallida conservando el tema guardado en página y controles.

public-contact-submit.name: Contact Form Submit
public-contact-submit.description: Submit a contact form to reach the company. On API failure the page renders the localized contact-submit-error message and stays on the form (2026-08).

public-financing-explainer.name: Public Partnership Program Explainer

public-financing-guide.name: Public Financing Guide
public-financing-guide.description: First-time visitor sees the financing guide once, starting at the explainer video card, and can reopen it later from the floating restart control.

public-financing-language.name: Public Financing Language
public-financing-language.description: Visitor switches the financing module between its Spanish and English canonical routes and receives localized program content.

public-financing-pdf.name: Public Financing PDF

public-financing-share.name: Public Financing Share

public-proposal-personalized-video.description: Guest chooses Executive or Complete view and opens the personalized video immediately after the greeting. Missing resources omit the section. Playback errors provide retry.

public-secure-link-reveal.description: A recipient opens a token held in the URL fragment. Loading displays type, sender and expiry without consuming the link; explicitly selecting Show content reveals it once and consumes it. Used, expired, revoked, invalid and team-only links show a non-content state; team-only links direct the recipient to team sign-in.
